لَّا يَاۡتِيۡهِ الۡبَاطِلُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَلَا مِنۡ خَلۡفِهٖؕ تَنۡزِيۡلٌ مِّنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ حَمِيۡدٍ
that cannot be approached by falsehood, neither from its front, nor from its behind -a revelation from the All-Wise, the Ever-Praised.
مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدۡ قِيۡلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوۡ مَغۡفِرَةٍ وَّذُوۡ عِقَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
Nothing is being said to you but what has been said to the messengers before you. Your Lord is certainly the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of painful punishment.

وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡاٰنًا اَعۡجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ اٰيٰتُهٗؕ ءَاَۙعۡجَمِيٌّ وَّعَرَبِيٌّؕ قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا هُدًي وَّشِفَآءٌؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٌ وَّهُوَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ عَمًيؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوۡنَ مِنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍࣖ‏

Had We made it a non-Arabic Qur’ān, they would have said, “Why are its verses not clearly explained? Is it a non-Arabic (book) and an Arab (messenger)?” Say, “For those who believe, it is guidance and cure. As for those who do not believe, there is deafness in their ears, and for them it is blindness. Such people are being called from a distant place.”
وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ فَاخۡتُلِفَ فِيۡهِؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيۡبٍ

And We gave Mūsā the book, then it was disputed (as well). But for a word that had already come from your Lord, the matter would have been decided between them. They are in confounding doubt about it.
مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلۡعَبِيۡدِ
If someone acts righteously, he does so for the benefit of his own soul, and if someone commits evil, he does so against it. Your Lord is not unjust to His servants.

اِلَيۡهِ يُرَدُّ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِؕ وَمَا تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ ثَمَرٰتٍ مِّنۡ اَكۡمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ اُنۡثٰي وَلَا تَضَعُ اِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهٖؕ وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيۡۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰذَنّٰكَۙ مَامِنَّا مِنۡ شَهِيۡدٍۚ‏

To Him alone the knowledge of the Hour (the exact time of Doomsday) is to be referred. No fruits come out of their sheaths, nor does a female conceive a baby, nor does she deliver it, but with His knowledge. And (remember) the Day when He will call them: “Where are My partners?” They will say, “We declare to you that no one of us is to testify (that you have partners).”
وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَظَنُّوۡا مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّحِيۡصٍ
And whatever they used to invoke earlier will vanish from them, and they will realize that they have no way to escape.
لَا يَسۡـَٔمُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مِنۡ دُعَآءِ الۡخَيۡرِؗ وَاِنۡ مَّسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوۡسٌ قَنُوۡطٌ
Man does not get weary of craving for (all sorts of ) good things; and if he is touched by some evil, he is disappointed, devoid of any hope.

وَلَئِنۡ اَذَقۡنٰهُ رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُوۡلَنَّ هٰذَا لِيۡۙ وَمَا٘ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۙ وَّلَئِنۡ رُّجِعۡتُ اِلٰي رَبِّيۡ٘ اِنَّ لِيۡ عِنۡدَهٗ لَلۡحُسۡنٰيۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِمَا عَمِلُوۡاؗ وَلَنُذِيۡقَنَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيۡظٍ

And if We give him a taste of some mercy from Us after some hardship that has touched him, he will surely say, “This is my right. And I do not think the Hour (the Day of Judgment) is going to occur. And even if I am brought back to my Lord, I will surely have the best (life) with Him (too).”So, We will let the disbelievers know what they did, and let them taste a stern punishment.
وَاِذَا٘ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَي الۡاِنۡسَانِ اَعۡرَضَ وَنَاٰبِجَانِبِهٖۚ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُوۡ دُعَآءٍ عَرِيۡضٍ
When We bestow Our favor upon man, he avoids (to appreciate it) and keeps himself far aside (from obedience), and when some evil touches him, he is full of lengthy prayers.
قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كَانَ مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرۡتُمۡ بِهٖ مَنۡ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ فِيۡ شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ
Say (to the disbelievers), “Tell me, if it (the Qur’ān) is from Allah, and still you reject it, then who can be more erroneous than him who is (involved) in far reaching schism?”
سَنُرِيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتِنَا فِي الۡاٰفَاقِ وَفِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ حَتّٰي يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ اَنَّهُ الۡحَقُّؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِ بِرَبِّكَ اَنَّهٗ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيۡدٌ
We will show them Our signs in the universe and within their own beings until it will become manifest to them that it is the truth. Is it not enough about your Lord that He is witness to everything?
اَلَا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ فِيۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ مُّحِيۡطٌࣖ‏
Beware, they are in doubt about meeting their Lord. Beware, He is the One who encompasses everything.
42: Hā Mīm
عٓسٓقٓ
‘Ain Sīn Qāf
كَذٰلِكَ يُوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡكَ وَاِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَۙ اللّٰهُ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
This is how Allah, the Mighty, the Wise, sends revelation to you and to those who were before you.
لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَلِيُّ الۡعَظِيۡمُ
To him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and He is the High, the Supreme.
تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهِنَّ وَالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ لِمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ

The heavens almost burst apart from their above side, and angels proclaim the purity and praise of their Lord, and pray for forgiveness of those on the earth. Be aware that Allah is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.
وَالَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَ اللّٰهُ حَفِيۡظٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡؗۖ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِوَكِيۡلٍ
And those who have adopted patrons instead of Him, Allah is on watch against them, and you are not responsible for them.
وَكَذٰلِكَ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنۡذِرَ اُمَّ الۡقُرٰي وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَتُنۡذِرَ يَوۡمَ الۡجَمۡعِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِؕ فَرِيۡقٌ فِي الۡجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيۡقٌ فِي السَّعِيۡرِ

And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān, so that you may warn the mother town, and those around it, and warn (them) of the Day of Gathering, about which there is no doubt-(when) one group of people will be in Paradise, and another group in blazing Fire.
وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَعَلَهُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلٰكِنۡ يُّدۡخِلُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ وَالظّٰلِمُوۡنَ مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍ
Had Allah willed, He would have made all of them a single group; but He admits whomsoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, they have neither a patron nor a helper.
اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَۚ فَاللّٰهُ هُوَ الۡوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحۡيِ الۡمَوۡتٰيؗ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌࣖ‏
Is it that they have adopted patrons instead of Him? So, it is Allah who is the Patron, and He gives life to the dead, and He is Powerful to do every thing.
وَمَا اخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَحُكۡمُهٗ٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبِّيۡ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُࣗۖ وَاِلَيۡهِ اُنِيۡبُ

And (Say O prophet to your opponents,) “Whatever dispute you have in any matter, its judgment lies with Allah. That One is Allah, the Lord of mine; in Him alone I have placed my trust, and to Him alone I turn (in every matter).”
فَاطِرُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ اَزۡوَاجًا وَّمِنَ الۡاَنۡعَامِ اَزۡوَاجًاۚ يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيۡهِؕ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهٖ شَيۡءٌۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُ

He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you pairs from among yourselves, and pairs from the cattle. He makes you expand in this way. Nothing is like Him. And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
لَهٗ مَقَالِيۡدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِۚ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ
To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whomsoever He wills, and straitens (it for whomsoever He wills). Surely He is All-Knowing in respect of every thing.

شَرَعَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الدِّيۡنِ مَا وَصّٰي بِهٖ نُوۡحًا وَّالَّذِيۡ٘ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ وَمَا وَصَّيۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَمُوۡسٰي وَعِيۡسٰ٘ي اَنۡ اَقِيۡمُوا الدِّيۡنَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوۡا فِيۡهِؕ كَبُرَ عَلَي الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ مَا تَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِؕ اَللّٰهُ يَجۡتَبِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ مَنۡ يُّنِيۡبُؕ‏

He has ordained for you people the same religion as He had enjoined upon NūH, and that which We have revealed to you (O prophet,) and that which We had enjoined upon Ibrāhīm and Mūsā and ‘Īsā by saying, “Establish the religion, and be not divided therein.” Arduous for the mushriks (polytheists) is that to which you are inviting them. Allah chooses (and pulls) toward Himself anyone He wills, and guides to Himself anyone who turns to Him (to seek guidance).

وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيًاۭ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي لَّقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَاِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡرِثُوا الۡكِتٰبَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيۡبٍ

And they were not divided, in jealousy with each other, but after the knowledge had come to them. Had it not been for a word that had come forth earlier from your Lord (and was effective) until a specified time, the matter would have been decided between them. And those who were made to inherit the Book after them are in confounding doubt about it.

فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادۡعُۚ وَاسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَا٘ اُمِرۡتَۚ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَقُلۡ اٰمَنۡتُ بِمَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ كِتٰبٍۚ وَاُمِرۡتُ لِاَعۡدِلَ بَيۡنَكُمۡؕ اَللّٰهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمۡؕ لَنَا٘ اَعۡمَالُنَا وَلَكُمۡ اَعۡمَالُكُمۡؕ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمۡؕ اَللّٰهُ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَاۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ الۡمَصِيۡرُؕ‏

So, (O prophet,) towards that (faith) invite (people), and be steadfast as you are commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say, “I believe in whatever book Allah has sent down. And I have been ordered to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you, your deeds. There is no argumentation between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the final return.”
وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُحَآجُّوۡنَ فِي اللّٰهِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا اسۡتُجِيۡبَ لَهٗ حُجَّتُهُمۡ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبٌ وَّلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌ
Those who argue about Allah after He has been responded to, their argument is void in the sight of their Lord, and upon them is wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡزَلَ الۡكِتٰبَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَؕ وَمَا يُدۡرِيۡكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيۡبٌ
Allah is the One who has sent down the Book with truth, and the Balance as well. And what can let you know? May be, the Hour (the Day of Judgment) is near.

يَسۡتَعۡجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهَاۚ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مُشۡفِقُوۡنَ مِنۡهَاۙ وَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ اَنَّهَا الۡحَقُّؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يُمَارُوۡنَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ

Those who do not believe in it demand that it should come soon, and those who believe are fearful of it, and they know for sure that it is the truth. Be aware that those who dispute concerning the Hour are wandering afar from the right path.
اَللّٰهُ لَطِيۡفٌۭ بِعِبَادِهٖ يَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ الۡقَوِيُّ الۡعَزِيۡزُࣖ‏
Allah is kind to His servants. He gives provision to whom He wills, and He is the Strong, the Mighty.
مَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ حَرۡثَ الۡاٰخِرَةِ نَزِدۡ لَهٗ فِيۡ حَرۡثِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ حَرۡثَ الدُّنۡيَا نُؤۡتِهٖ مِنۡهَاۙ وَمَا لَهٗ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ مِنۡ نَّصِيۡبٍ

Whoever intends (to have) the harvest of the Hereafter, We will increase in his harvest; and whoever intends (to have) the harvest of the world (only), We will give him thereof, while in the Hereafter he will have no share.
اَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكٰٓؤُا شَرَعُوۡا لَهُمۡ مِّنَ الدِّيۡنِ مَا لَمۡ يَاۡذَنۭۡ بِهِ اللّٰهُؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةُ الۡفَصۡلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ

Is it that they have associate-gods who have prescribed for them a religion that is not sanctioned by Allah? Had it not been for a decisive word, the matter would have been decided between them (here in this world). And of course, for the wrongdoers there is a painful punishment (in the Hereafter).

تَرَي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوۡا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۭ بِهِمۡؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فِيۡ رَوۡضٰتِ الۡجَنّٰتِۚ لَهُمۡ مَّا يَشَآءُوۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَضۡلُ الۡكَبِيۡرُ

You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they earned, and it is sure to befall them. As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they will be in meadows of the Gardens. For them there is, with their Lord, whatever they wish. That is the great bounty.

ذٰلِكَ الَّذِيۡ يُبَشِّرُ اللّٰهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ قُلۡ لَّا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اَجۡرًا اِلَّا الۡمَوَدَّةَ فِي الۡقُرۡبٰيؕ وَمَنۡ يَّقۡتَرِفۡ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدۡ لَهٗ فِيۡهَا حُسۡنًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ شَكُوۡرٌ

That is the good news that Allah gives to His servants who believed and did righteous deeds. Say, “I do not ask you any fee for it, except the love of kinship.” And whoever performs a good act, We will increase for him goodness therein. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Appreciative.
اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۚ فَاِنۡ يَّشَاِ اللّٰهُ يَخۡتِمۡ عَلٰي قَلۡبِكَؕ وَيَمۡحُ اللّٰهُ الۡبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ

Is it that they say, “He has forged a lie against Allah”? So, if Allah wills, He may put a seal on your heart. And Allah blots out falsehood and establishes truth with His words. Surely, He is fully aware of what lies in the hearts.
وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ يَقۡبَلُ التَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَعۡفُوۡا عَنِ السَّيِّاٰتِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُوۡنَۙ‏
And He is the One who accepts repentance from His servants and forgives evil deeds and knows whatever you do.
وَيَسۡتَجِيۡبُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَيَزِيۡدُهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَضۡلِهٖؕ وَالۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌ
And He responds to (the prayer of) those who believe and do righteous deeds, and gives them more out of His grace. As for the disbelievers, for them there is a severe punishment.
وَلَوۡ بَسَطَ اللّٰهُ الرِّزۡقَ لِعِبَادِهٖ لَبَغَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلٰكِنۡ يُّنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيۡرٌۭ بَصِيۡرٌ

Should Allah expand the provision for His servants (to its full extent), they would spread mischief on earth; but He sends down what He wills in (due) measure. Surely, with regard to His slaves, He is All-Aware, Ever-Watchful.
وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُنَزِّلُ الۡغَيۡثَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا قَنَطُوۡا وَيَنۡشُرُ رَحۡمَتَهٗؕ وَهُوَ الۡوَلِيُّ الۡحَمِيۡدُ
And He is the One who sends down rain after they have lost hope, and He extends His mercy. And He is the Guardian, Worthy of all praise.
وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ خَلۡقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيۡهِمَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍؕ وَهُوَ عَلٰي جَمۡعِهِمۡ اِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيۡرٌࣖ‏
Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the creatures He has spread in them. He is Powerful to assemble them whenever He so wills.
وَمَا٘ اَصَابَكُمۡ مِّنۡ مُّصِيۡبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ وَيَعۡفُوۡا عَنۡ كَثِيۡرٍؕ‏
Whatever hardship befalls you is because of what your own hands have committed, while He overlooks many (of your faults).
وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِۚۖ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍ
You are not able to frustrate (Him) in the earth. And, besides Allah, you have neither someone to protect, nor someone to help.
وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهِ الۡجَوَارِ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ كَالۡاَعۡلَامِؕ‏
And among His signs are ships in the sea, like mountains.
اِنۡ يَّشَاۡ يُسۡكِنِ الرِّيۡحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلٰي ظَهۡرِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوۡرٍۙ‏
If He so wills, He may stop the wind, and they stand still on its surface. Surely in this, there are signs for everyone who is ever patient, fully grateful.
اَوۡ يُوۡبِقۡهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوۡا وَيَعۡفُ عَنۡ كَثِيۡرٍۙ‏
Or He may destroy them because of what they earned, and may overlook many (whom He may save at least in this world),
وَّيَعۡلَمَ الَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِنَاؕ مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّحِيۡصٍ
and (in such an event) those who raise disputes in Our verses will come to know that there is no way for them to escape.
فَمَا٘ اُوۡتِيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَمَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰي لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَۚ‏
So, whatever thing has been given to you is an enjoyment of the worldly life. And that which is with Allah is much better, and much more durable for those who believe and place their trust in Allah,
وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَجۡتَنِبُوۡنَ كَبٰٓئِرَ الۡاِثۡمِ وَالۡفَوَاحِشَ وَاِذَا مَا غَضِبُوۡا هُمۡ يَغۡفِرُوۡنَۚ‏
and (for) those who abstain from the major sins and from shameful acts; and (for those who) when they get angry, they forgive,
وَالَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَجَابُوۡا لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَاَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَࣕ وَاَمۡرُهُمۡ شُوۡرٰي بَيۡنَهُمۡࣕ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَۚ‏

and those who have responded to their Lord (in submission to Him), and have established Salāh, and whose affairs are (settled) with mutual consultation between them, and who spend out of what We have given to them,
وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا٘ اَصَابَهُمُ الۡبَغۡيُ هُمۡ يَنۡتَصِرُوۡنَ
and those who, when they are subjected to aggression, defend themselves.
وَجَزٰٓؤُا سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثۡلُهَاۚ فَمَنۡ عَفَا وَاَصۡلَحَ فَاَجۡرُهٗ عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
The recompense of evil is evil like it. Then the one who forgives and opts for compromise has his reward undertaken by Allah. Surely, He does not like the unjust.
وَلَمَنِ انۡتَصَرَ بَعۡدَ ظُلۡمِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ سَبِيۡلٍؕ‏
The one who defends himself after having been wronged, there is no blame on such people.
اِنَّمَا السَّبِيۡلُ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ النَّاسَ وَيَبۡغُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
Blame, in fact, is upon those who wrong people and make mischief on earth unjustly. For such people there is a painful punishment.
وَلَمَنۡ صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنۡ عَزۡمِ الۡاُمُوۡرِࣖ‏
And if one observes patience and forgives, it is, of course, one of the courageous conducts.
وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖؕ وَتَرَي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الۡعَذَابَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ هَلۡ اِلٰي مَرَدٍّ مِّنۡ سَبِيۡلٍۚ‏

The one whom Allah lets go astray, there is no one for him to protect thereafter. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they will see the punishment, that they will say, “Is there any way to be sent back (to the world)? ”

وَتَرٰىهُمۡ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا خٰشِعِيۡنَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ مِنۡ طَرۡفٍ خَفِيٍّؕ وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَاَهۡلِيۡهِمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ فِيۡ عَذَابٍ مُّقِيۡمٍ

And you will see them that they will be presented to it (the Fire), downcast because of humiliation, looking with stealthy glance. And those who believe will say, “The real losers are those who have lost their own selves and their families on the Day of Judgment.” Be aware that the wrongdoers are in lasting punishment.
وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ سَبِيۡلٍؕ‏
And for them there will not be any friends who may help them besides Allah. And the one whom Allah lets go astray, for him there is no way (to save himself).
اِسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لِرَبِّكُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَ يَوۡمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِؕ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّلۡجَاٍ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ وَّمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّكِيۡرٍ

Respond to your Lord before there comes a day for which there will be no reversal from Allah’s side. For you there will be neither a refuge that day, nor an opportunity to question (Allah about your fate).

فَاِنۡ اَعۡرَضُوۡا فَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيۡظًاؕ اِنۡ عَلَيۡكَ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُؕ وَاِنَّا٘ اِذَا٘ اَذَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَاۚ وَاِنۡ تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةٌۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ فَاِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ كَفُوۡرٌ

So, if they turn away, then We did not send you (O Prophet,) as a supervisor over them. You are not responsible but for conveying the message. And when We make man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices with it, and if an evil befalls him because of what their hands sent ahead, then man becomes ungrateful.
لِلّٰهِ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُؕ يَهَبُ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ اِنَاثًا وَّيَهَبُ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ الذُّكُوۡرَۙ‏
To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills. He grants females to whom He wills, and grants males to whom He wills.
اَوۡ يُزَوِّجُهُمۡ ذُكۡرَانًا وَّاِنَاثًاۚ وَيَجۡعَلُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ عَقِيۡمًاؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌ قَدِيۡرٌ
Or He combines for them couples, both males and females, and makes whom He wills barren. Surely, He is All-Knowing, Very-Powerful.
وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَنۡ يُّكَلِّمَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا وَحۡيًا اَوۡ مِنۡ وَّرَآئِ حِجَابٍ اَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُوۡلًا فَيُوۡحِيَ بِاِذۡنِهٖ مَا يَشَآءُؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيۡمٌ

It is not (possible) for a human being that Allah speaks to him, except by way of revelation, or from behind a curtain, or that He sends a messenger, and he reveals, with His permission, what He wills. Surely, He is All-High, All-Wise.

وَكَذٰلِكَ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ رُوۡحًا مِّنۡ اَمۡرِنَاؕ مَا كُنۡتَ تَدۡرِيۡ مَا الۡكِتٰبُ وَلَا الۡاِيۡمَانُ وَلٰكِنۡ جَعَلۡنٰهُ نُوۡرًا نَّهۡدِيۡ بِهٖ مَنۡ نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاؕ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍۙ‏

In similar way, We have revealed to you a Spirit from Our command. You did not know earlier what was the Book or what was Īmān (true faith), but We have made it (the Qur’ān) a light with which We guide whomsoever We will from among Our servants. And indeed you are guiding (people) to a straight path,
صِرَاطِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ اَلَا٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ تَصِيۡرُ الۡاُمُوۡرُࣖ‏
the path of Allah, the One to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Be aware that towards Allah all matters shall finally return.
43: Hā Mīm.
وَالۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِۛۙ‏
By the manifest Book,
اِنَّا جَعَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَۚ‏
We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān, so that you may understand.
وَاِنَّهٗ فِيۡ٘ اُمِّ الۡكِتٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيۡمٌؕ‏
And it is, in the Mother of the Book (the Preserved Tablet) with us, surely sublime, full of wisdom.
اَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنۡكُمُ الذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا اَنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا مُّسۡرِفِيۡنَ
Shall We then take the advice away from you because you are a transgressing people?
وَكَمۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ نَّبِيٍّ فِي الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
How many a messenger We have sent to the earlier people!
وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ نَّبِيٍّ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
No messenger came to them, but they used to mock at him.
فَاَهۡلَكۡنَا٘ اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ بَطۡشًا وَّمَضٰي مَثَلُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
So We have destroyed those who were stronger than these (people of Makkah) in power, and the example of the earlier people has already passed.
وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۙ‏
Should you ask them as to who has created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “They are created by the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing,”
الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَۚ‏
the One who has made the earth a cradle for you, and has made for you pathways therein, so that you may be guided,
وَالَّذِيۡ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ بِقَدَرٍۚ فَاَنۡشَرۡنَا بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًاۚ كَذٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَ
and the One who has sent down water from the sky in due measure. Then We have revived with it a dead town. In the same way, you will be brought forth (alive from the graves),
وَالَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡفُلۡكِ وَالۡاَنۡعَامِ مَا تَرۡكَبُوۡنَۙ‏
and the One who has created all the pairs, and has made for you the boats and the cattle that you ride,
لِتَسۡتَوٗا عَلٰي ظُهُوۡرِهٖ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ اِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُوۡلُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِيۡ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقۡرِنِيۡنَۙ‏

so that you may mount upon their back, then recall the favour of your Lord after having mounted upon it and say, “Pure is the One who has subjugated this for us, and We were not able to have control over it,
وَاِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا لَمُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ
and of course, towards our Lord we have to return.”
وَجَعَلُوۡا لَهٗ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ جُزۡءًاؕ اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لَكَفُوۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌࣖؕ‏
They have attributed to Him (that He is composed of) parts, (and that too) out of His servants. Surely, man is clearly ungrateful.
اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنٰتٍ وَّاَصۡفٰىكُمۡ بِالۡبَنِيۡنَ
Is it that He has adopted daughters from those whom He has created, and chosen you for (having) sons?
وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمۡ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهٗ مُسۡوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌ
When one of them is given the good news of (the birth of) that which he has attributed to RaHmān (i.e. the daughters), his face turns black, and he becomes choked with sorrow.
اَوَمَنۡ يُّنَشَّؤُا فِي الۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِيۡنٍ
Is it that (Allah has chosen) those (as His offspring) who are grown up in ornaments and who cannot express themselves in debate clearly?
وَجَعَلُوا الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عِبٰدُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اِنَاثًاؕ اَشَهِدُوۡا خَلۡقَهُمۡ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
They have held angels, who are the servants of RaHmān, as females. Have they witnessed their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنٰهُمۡؕ مَا لَهُمۡ بِذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍࣗ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَخۡرُصُوۡنَؕ‏
They say, “Had the RaHmān so willed, we would not have worshipped them.” They have no knowledge of that. They do nothing but make conjectures.
اَمۡ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ كِتٰبًا مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ فَهُمۡ بِهٖ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُوۡنَ
Or have We given to them a book before this, and they are adhering to it?
بَلۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰ٘ي اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰ٘ي اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
Instead, they say, “We have found our fathers on a certain way, and we are on their footprints, fully guided.”
وَكَذٰلِكَ مَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِيۡ قَرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوۡهَا٘ۙ اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰ٘ي اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰ٘ي اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدُوۡنَ
Similarly, We did not send a warner to a town before you, but its affluent people said, “We have found our fathers on a certain way, and we are following their footprints.”
قٰلَ اَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِاَهۡدٰي مِمَّا وَجَدۡتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اٰبَآءَكُمۡؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
He said, “Even if I bring to you something better in guidance than that on which you have found your fathers?” They said, “We totally disbelieve in what you are sent with.”
فَانۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَࣖ‏
So, We took revenge from them. Now look, how was the end of those who rejected (Our messengers).
وَاِذۡ قَالَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِنَّنِيۡ بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَۙ‏
(Recall) when Ibrāhīm said to his father and to his people, “I disown that which you worship,
اِلَّا الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنِيۡ فَاِنَّهٗ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ
except the One who has originated me; so He will guide me.”
وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۭ بَاقِيَةً فِيۡ عَقِبِهٖ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
He made it a word lasting among his posterity, so that they may return.
بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰي جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ وَرَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
But, I gave these and their fathers enjoyment, until the truth came to them, and a messenger as well who explains (it).
وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ وَّاِنَّا بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally disbelieve in it.”
وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنُ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيۡمٍ
They say, “Why was this Qur’ān not revealed on a great man from (either of) the two towns?”

اَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُوۡنَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَؕ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ مَّعِيۡشَتَهُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ بَعۡضًا سُخۡرِيًّاؕ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُوۡنَ

Is it they who allocate the mercy of your Lord? We have allocated among them their livelihood in the worldly life, and have raised some of them over others in ranks, so that some of them may put some others to work. And the mercy of your Lord is much better than what they accumulate.
وَلَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ لِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ سُقُفًا مِّنۡ فِضَّةٍ وَّمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُوۡنَۙ‏

Were it not that all people would become of a single creed (i.e. disbelief), We would have caused, for those who disbelieve in RaHmān, roofs of their houses to be made of silver, and the stairs as well, on which they would climb,
وَلِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ اَبۡوَابًا وَّسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔوۡنَۙ‏
and doors of their homes, and the coaches on which they would recline,
وَزُخۡرُفًاؕ وَاِنۡ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاؕ وَالۡاٰخِرَةُ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَࣖ‏
and (would have made some of these things) of gold-ornaments. And all this is nothing but an enjoyment of the worldly life. And the Hereafter, with your Lord, is (destined) for the God-fearing.
وَمَنۡ يَّعۡشُ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهٗ شَيۡطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِيۡنٌ
Whoever makes himself blind against the advice of RaHmān, We assign for him a devil who accompanies him all the time.
وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّوۡنَهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ وَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
And they (the devils) prevent such people from the (right) way, while they deem themselves to be on the right path,
حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ الۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرِيۡنُ
until when such a person will come to us, he will say (to the devil), “Would that there were the distance of East and West between me and you, because you were the worst companion.”
وَلَنۡ يَّنۡفَعَكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ اِذۡ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ فِي الۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُوۡنَ
And (it will be said to such people,) “Since you were wrongdoers, it will never benefit you today that you are sharing the punishment with each other.”
اَفَاَنۡتَ تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوۡ تَهۡدِي الۡعُمۡيَ وَمَنۡ كَانَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
So, can you (O prophet) make the deaf to hear, or can you show the way to the blind and the one who is in open error?
فَاِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنۡهُمۡ مُّنۡتَقِمُوۡنَۙ‏
So, even if We take you away, We will surely take vengeance on them.
اَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِيۡ وَعَدۡنٰهُمۡ فَاِنَّا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدِرُوۡنَ
Or (if) We show you (in your life) that (punishment) with which We have threatened them, then We have full control over them.
فَاسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡكَۚ اِنَّكَ عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
So, hold fast to that which has been revealed to you. Surely, you are on the straight path.
وَاِنَّهٗ لَذِكۡرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۚ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
And certainly this (Qur’ān) is a word of honour for you and your people, and you will be questioned.
وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡ رُّسُلِنَا٘ࣗ اَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اٰلِهَةً يُّعۡبَدُوۡنَࣖ‏
Ask Our messengers whom We sent before you whether We had appointed gods to be worshipped besides RaHmān.
وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ فَقَالَ اِنِّيۡ رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
We sent Mūsā with Our signs to Fir’aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs; so he said, “I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds.”
فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِذَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَ
So, when he came to them with Our signs, they at once started laughing at them.
وَمَا نُرِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ اِلَّا هِيَ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ اُخۡتِهَاؗ وَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
And We did not show them a sign, but it used to be greater than the one that preceded it. And We seized them with punishment, so that they may return.
وَقَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنۡدَكَۚ اِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُوۡنَ
And they said, “O magician, pray for us to your Lord by the covenant He has made with you; we will certainly come to guidance.”
فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمۡ يَنۡكُثُوۡنَ
Then, once We removed the punishment from them, in no time they broke their promise.
وَنَادٰي فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِيۡ قَوۡمِهٖ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَلَيۡسَ لِيۡ مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهٰذِهِ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِيۡۚ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
And Fir’aun (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people, saying, “Does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers are flowing right underneath me? Do you, then, not discern?
اَمۡ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ هُوَ مَهِيۡنٌ ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَكَادُ يُبِيۡنُ
Or (do you not see that) I am much better than this one (Mūsā) who is worthless and can hardly express himself?
فَلَوۡلَا٘ اُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ اَسۡوِرَةٌ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ اَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِيۡنَ
So why were the bracelets of gold not sent down to him, or (why) did the angels not come along with him as companions?”
فَاسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهٗ فَاَطَاعُوۡهُؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ
Thus he made fool of his people, and they obeyed him. Surely they were a sinful people.
فَلَمَّا٘ اٰسَفُوۡنَا انۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
So, when they provoked Our anger, We took vengeance on them, and drowned them all together,
فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ سَلَفًا وَّمَثَلًا لِّلۡاٰخِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
and made them a people of the past, and an example for the later generations.
وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا اِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّوۡنَ
When the example of the son of Maryam was cited, your people started at once shouting at it (in joy),
وَقَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ هُوَؕ مَا ضَرَبُوۡهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًاؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُوۡنَ
and said, “Are Our gods better or is he?” They did not cite it (the example) but for the sake of disputation. Rather, they are a quarrelsome people.
اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبۡدٌ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
He (‘Īsā) is no more than a servant (of Allah) whom We favoured and made an example for the children of Isrā’īl.
وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡكُمۡ مَّلٰٓئِكَةً فِي الۡاَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُوۡنَ
And if We will, We may create angels from you who succeed you on the earth.
وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلۡمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوۡنِؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
And he (‘Īsā) is a source of knowledge of the Hour (the Day of Judgment); so do not be in doubt about it, and follow me. This is the straight way.
وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
And let not the ShaiTān (Satan) prevent you (from following this way). He is surely an open enemy for you.
وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيۡسٰي بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِالۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِاُبَيِّنَ لَكُمۡ بَعۡضَ الَّذِيۡ تَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ فِيۡهِۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِ
When ‘Īsā came with clear proofs, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to explain to you some of those matters in which you differ. So, fear Allah, and obey me.
اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ رَبِّيۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
Surely, it is Allah who is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is the straight way.”
فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِهِمۡۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
Then different groups, out of them, fell into disagreement. Woe to the wrongdoers because of the punishment of a painful day!
هَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
They are waiting for nothing but for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they would not even imagine (it).
اَلۡاَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذٍۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَࣖؕ‏
Friends, on that day, will become enemies to one another, except the God-fearing,
يٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ وَلَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُوۡنَۚ‏
(to whom it will be said) “O my servants, there is no fear for you today, nor will you grieve-
اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَۚ‏
-O those (servants) who believed in Our signs, and remained obedient.
اُدۡخُلُوا الۡجَنَّةَ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُوۡنَ
- Enter the Paradise, you and your spouses, showered with bliss.”
يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِصِحَافٍ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ وَّاَكۡوَابٍۚ وَفِيۡهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيۡهِ الۡاَنۡفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الۡاَعۡيُنُۚ وَاَنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
Circulated among them will be the bowls of gold, and glasses. And there will be whatever souls desire and that which eyes enjoy. “And you will be living in it for ever.
وَتِلۡكَ الۡجَنَّةُ الَّتِيۡ٘ اُوۡرِثۡتُمُوۡهَا بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
That is the Paradise you are made to inherit because of what you used to do.
لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيۡرَةٌ مِّنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
For you there are fruits in abundance from which you will eat.”
اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ فِيۡ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
The sinners (on the other hand) will be in the punishment of Jahannam (Hell), living there forever.
لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَۚ‏
It will not be lightened for them, and they will be there, devoid of all hopes.
وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
We did not do injustice to them, rather, they themselves were the unjust.
وَنَادَوۡا يٰمٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَؕ قَالَ اِنَّكُمۡ مّٰكِثُوۡنَ
And they will call (Mālik, the keeper of the Hell,) “O Mālik, let your Lord do away with us.” He will say, “You have to stay on.”
لَقَدۡ جِئۡنٰكُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ
(O disbelievers,) indeed We have brought to you the truth, but it is the truth that most of you detest.
اَمۡ اَبۡرَمُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّا مُبۡرِمُوۡنَۚ‏
Is it that they have firmly resolved to do something (harmful to Our messenger)? Then, We have firmly resolved (to frustrate their plan.)
اَمۡ يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوٰىهُمۡؕ بَلٰي وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَ
Do they think that We do not hear their secrets and their whispers? Yes of course, Our messengers (angels) are with them who record (whatever they plan).
قُلۡ اِنۡ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدٌࣗۖ فَاَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡعٰبِدِيۡنَ
Say, “Had there been a son for the RaHmān, I would have been the first to worship.”
سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ رَبِّ الۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ
Pure is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from what they attribute (to Him).
فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوۡضُوۡا وَيَلۡعَبُوۡا حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِيۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
So, let them indulge (in their fallacy) and play, until they face their Day that they are promised.
وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ فِي السَّمَآءِ اِلٰهٌ وَّفِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلٰهٌؕ وَهُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
He is the One who is God to be worshipped in the sky, and God to be worshipped on the earth. And He is the Wise, the All-Knowing.
وَتَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۚ وَعِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
Glorious is the One to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and towards Him you are to be returned.
وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَهِدَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
And those whom they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede; but those who bear witness to the truth, while they have knowledge (may intercede for the believers with Allah’s permission).
وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُ فَاَنّٰي يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَۙ‏
And if you ask them as to who has created them, they will certainly say, “Allah”. Then, to where are they driven back (by their false desires)?
وَقِيۡلِهٖ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٌ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۘ‏
And (Allah has the knowledge) of his (prophet’s) saying, “O my Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”
فَاصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلٰمٌؕ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
So, turn away from them, and say, “Salām !” (good-bye!). Then, soon they will come to know (the end of their attitude).
44: Hā Mīm .
وَالۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِۙۛ‏
By the manifest Book,
اِنَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ فِيۡ لَيۡلَةٍ مُّبٰرَكَةٍ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنۡذِرِيۡنَ
We have sent it down in a blessed night, (because) We had to warn (people).
فِيۡهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ اَمۡرٍ حَكِيۡمٍۙ‏
In that (night), every wise matter is allocated
اَمۡرًا مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَاؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِيۡنَۚ‏
through a command from Us. We were to send the Messenger
رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۙ‏
as a mercy from your Lord, -Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing-
رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِيۡنَ
the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever there is between them, if you are to believe.
لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيٖ وَيُمِيۡتُؕ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ اٰبَآئِكُمُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
There is no god, but He. He gives life and brings death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
بَلۡ هُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ يَّلۡعَبُوۡنَ
But they, being in doubt, are playing around.
فَارۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَاۡتِي السَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
So, wait for a day when the sky will come up with a visible smoke
يَّغۡشَي النَّاسَؕ هٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
that will envelop people. This is a painful punishment.
رَبَّنَا اكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا الۡعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
(Then they will say,) “O our Lord, remove from us the punishment; we will truly believe.”
اَنّٰي لَهُمُ الذِّكۡرٰي وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
How will they take lesson, while there has already come to them a messenger making things clear?
ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡا عَنۡهُ وَقَالُوۡا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجۡنُوۡنٌۘ‏
Then they turned away from him, and said, “(He is) tutored, crazy.”
اِنَّا كَاشِفُوا الۡعَذَابِ قَلِيۡلًا اِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُوۡنَۘ‏
(Well,) We are going to remove the punishment for a while, (but) you will certainly go back (to your original position).
يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ الۡبَطۡشَةَ الۡكُبۡرٰيۚ اِنَّا مُنۡتَقِمُوۡنَ
(Then,) the day We will seize (you) with the greatest seizure, We will take vengeance.
وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ كَرِيۡمٌۙ‏
And We tested the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) prior to them, and a noble messenger came to them
اَنۡ اَدُّوۡ٘ا اِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ اَمِيۡنٌۙ‏
saying, “Deliver to me the servants of Allah. I am an honest messenger to you,”
وَّاَنۡ لَّا تَعۡلُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۚ‏
and saying, “Do not be haughty against Allah. I bring to you a clear proof.
وَاِنِّيۡ عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّيۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡ اَنۡ تَرۡجُمُوۡنِۚ‏
And I have sought refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death.
وَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُوۡا لِيۡ فَاعۡتَزِلُوۡنِ
And if you do not believe in me, then keep away from me.”
فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٌ مُّجۡرِمُوۡنَ
Then he prayed to his Lord saying, “These are a guilty people.”
فَاَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيۡ لَيۡلًا اِنَّكُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَۙ‏
(So, Allah answered his prayer saying,) “Now, take away my servants at night. You will certainly be chased,
وَاتۡرُكِ الۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ
and leave the sea in the state of stillness; they are an army that is sure to be drowned.”
كَمۡ تَرَكُوۡا مِنۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۙ‏
How many gardens and fountains have they left behind-
وَّزُرُوۡعٍ وَّمَقَامٍ كَرِيۡمٍۙ‏
- and how many fields and noble sites,
وَّنَعۡمَةٍ كَانُوۡا فِيۡهَا فٰكِهِيۡنَۙ‏
and how many a luxury they used to rejoice in!
كَذٰلِكَࣞ وَاَوۡرَثۡنٰهَا قَوۡمًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ
This is how it happened. And We made other people inherit all this.
فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ السَّمَآءُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُوۡا مُنۡظَرِيۡنَࣖ‏
So, neither the sky and earth wept over them, nor were they given a respite.
وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ الۡمُهِيۡنِۙ‏
And We delivered the children of Isrā’īl from the humiliating punishment,
مِنۡ فِرۡعَوۡنَؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ
from Fir‘aun. Indeed, he was haughty, one of the transgressors.
وَلَقَدِ اخۡتَرۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰي عِلۡمٍ عَلَي الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
And We chose them, with knowledge, above all the worlds.
وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاٰيٰتِ مَا فِيۡهِ بَلٰٓؤٌا مُّبِيۡنٌ
And We gave them the clear signs in which there was a manifest blessing.
اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ‏
These people say,
اِنۡ هِيَ اِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا الۡاُوۡلٰي وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنۡشَرِيۡنَ
“There is nothing more than our first death, and we are not going to be resurrected.
فَاۡتُوۡا بِاٰبَآئِنَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
So, (O believers,) bring our fathers, if you are true (in your belief in resurrection.)”
اَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٍۙ وَّالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡؗ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those who were before them? We have destroyed them. They were guilty indeed.
وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيۡنَ
And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them just as players.
مَا خَلَقۡنٰهُمَا٘ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
We did not create them but with true purpose, but most of them do not know.
اِنَّ يَوۡمَ الۡفَصۡلِ مِيۡقَاتُهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
The Day of Decision is the appointed time for all of them-
يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِيۡ مَوۡلًي عَنۡ مَّوۡلًي شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَۙ‏
the day when no close relation will be of any use to any close relation, nor will they be helped,
اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الرَّحِيۡمُࣖ‏
except the One on whom Allah has mercy. Of course, He is the All-Mighty, the Very-Merciful.
اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوۡمِۙ‏
Indeed the tree of zaqqūm
طَعَامُ الۡاَثِيۡمِۚۛۖ‏
is the food of the sinful,
كَالۡمُهۡلِۚۛ يَغۡلِيۡ فِي الۡبُطُوۡنِۙ‏
like dregs of oil. It will boil in the bellies
كَغَلۡيِ الۡحَمِيۡمِ
like the boiling of hot water.
خُذُوۡهُ فَاعۡتِلُوۡهُ اِلٰي سَوَآءِ الۡجَحِيۡمِۙ‏
(It will be said to angels,) “Seize him, and drag him into the midst of the Hell.
ثُمَّ صُبُّوۡا فَوۡقَ رَاۡسِهٖ مِنۡ عَذَابِ الۡحَمِيۡمِؕ‏
Then pour on his head some torment of boiling water.”
ذُقۡۚۖ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡكَرِيۡمُ
“Have a taste! You are the ‘man of might’, the ‘man of honour’.
اِنَّ هٰذَا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَمۡتَرُوۡنَ
This is the thing about which you used to be skeptic.”
اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ مَقَامٍ اَمِيۡنٍۙ‏
Indeed the God-fearing will be in a place free from fear,
فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۚۙ‏
in gardens and fountains.
يَّلۡبَسُوۡنَ مِنۡ سُنۡدُسٍ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيۡنَۚۙ‏
They will be dressed in fine silk and thick silk, facing each other.
كَذٰلِكَࣞ وَزَوَّجۡنٰهُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِيۡنٍؕ‏
Thus (it will happen,) and We will marry them with houris having big dark eyes.
يَدۡعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ اٰمِنِيۡنَۙ‏
They will call therein for every fruit peacefully.
لَا يَذُوۡقُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا الۡمَوۡتَ اِلَّا الۡمَوۡتَةَ الۡاُوۡلٰيۚ وَوَقٰىهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِۙ‏
They will not taste death therein beyond the first death (they faced in the world). And He (Allah) will save them from the torment of Hell,
فَضۡلًا مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِيۡمُ
as a favour from your Lord. That is the great achievement.
فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
So, We had made it (the Qur’ān) easy in your tongue, so that they may take lesson.
فَارۡتَقِبۡ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّرۡتَقِبُوۡنَࣖ‏
Now wait. They too are waiting.
45: Hā Mīm .
تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ
This is revelation of the Book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
اِنَّ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
Surely in the heavens and the earth, there are signs for those who have faith.
وَفِيۡ خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ اٰيٰتٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّوۡقِنُوۡنَۙ‏
And in your creation and in the living beings that He scatters on the earth, there are signs for a people who believe.
وَاخۡتِلَافِ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مِنۡ رِّزۡقٍ فَاَحۡيَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيۡفِ الرِّيٰحِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ

And in the alternation of the day and the night, and in the provision He has sent down from the sky, then has revived the earth after its death, and in changing of the winds, there are signs for a people who understand.
تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَتۡلُوۡهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِالۡحَقِّۚ فَبِاَيِّ حَدِيۡثٍۭ بَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَاٰيٰتِهٖ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
These are Allah’s verses that We recite to you rightly. Then, in which discourse, after Allah and His verses, will they believe?
وَيۡلٌ لِّكُلِّ اَفَّاكٍ اَثِيۡمٍۙ‏
Woe to every sinful liar,
يَّسۡمَعُ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرًا كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۚ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
who hears Allah’s verses being recited to him, then he remains adamant out of arrogance, as if he never heard them. So give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment.
وَاِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا شَيۡـَٔا اِۨتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيۡنٌؕ‏
When he learns about something of Our verses, he takes it as a laughing stock. For such people, there is a humiliating punishment.
مِنۡ وَّرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۚ وَلَا يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَسَبُوۡا شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡلِيَآءَۚ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌؕ‏

In front of them, there is Jahannam (Hell). And whatever they have earned will not be of any use to them, nor the patrons they have adopted instead of Allah. And for them, there is a horrible punishment.
هٰذَا هُدًيۚ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ مِّنۡ رِّجۡزٍ اَلِيۡمٌࣖ‏
This is guidance, and those who reject the verses of their Lord, for them there is a painful punishment of the divine scourge.
اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ الۡفُلۡكُ فِيۡهِ بِاَمۡرِهٖ وَلِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَۚ‏
Allah is the One who has subjugated for you the sea, so that the ships may sail in it with His command, and so that you may seek His grace, and so that you offer gratitude.
وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمۡ مَّا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًا مِّنۡهُؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ
He has subjugated for you whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, all on His own. Surely in this there are signs for a people who reflect.
قُلۡ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا يَغۡفِرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ اَيَّامَ اللّٰهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمًاۭ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
Tell those who believe that they should forgive those who do not believe in Allah’s days, so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاؗ ثُمَّ اِلٰي رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
Whoever acts righteously, it is for his own benefit, and who does evil, it is against his own soul. Then towards your Lord, you will be returned.
وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ الۡكِتٰبَ وَالۡحُكۡمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنٰهُمۡ عَلَي الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
We gave the children of Isrā’īl the book and the wisdom and the prophet-hood, and provided them with good things, and preferred them above all (people of) the world,

وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بَيِّنٰتٍ مِّنَ الۡاَمۡرِۚ فَمَا اخۡتَلَفُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الۡعِلۡمُۙ بَغۡيًاۭ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِيۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فِيۡمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ

and We gave them clear proofs of the Matter (i.e. the religion). So they did not fall into disagreement out of mutual jealousy, but after the knowledge had come to them. Surely your Lord will judge between them, on the Day of Judgment, in the matters in which they used to differ.
ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنٰكَ عَلٰي شَرِيۡعَةٍ مِّنَ الۡاَمۡرِ فَاتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ اَهۡوَآءَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
Then We have put you on a certain way of the Matter (i.e. the religion); so follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.
اِنَّهُمۡ لَنۡ يُّغۡنُوۡا عَنۡكَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ اَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٍۚ وَاللّٰهُ وَلِيُّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ
They will never help you against Allah in the least. The wrongdoers are friends to one another, and Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.
هٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّوۡقِنُوۡنَ
These are insights for the people, and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
اَمۡ حَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ اجۡتَرَحُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنۡ نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِۙ سَوَآءً مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡؕ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُوۡنَࣖ‏
Do those who have committed evils assume that We will make them like those who believe and do righteous deeds, so as their life and death becomes equal? Evil is what they judge.
وَخَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزٰي كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
Allah has created the heavens and the earth with just purpose, and so that everybody is recompensed for what he (or she) earned, and they will not be wronged.

اَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰىهُ وَاَضَلَّهُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي عِلۡمٍ وَّخَتَمَ عَلٰي سَمۡعِهٖ وَقَلۡبِهٖ وَجَعَلَ عَلٰي بَصَرِهٖ غِشٰوَةًؕ فَمَنۡ يَّهۡدِيۡهِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ اللّٰهِؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ

So, have you seen him who has taken his desires as his god, and Allah has let him go astray, despite having knowledge, and has sealed his ear and his heart, and put a cover on his eye? Now who will guide him after Allah? Still, do you not take lesson?
وَقَالُوۡا مَا هِيَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنۡيَا نَمُوۡتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَا٘ اِلَّا الدَّهۡرُۚ وَمَا لَهُمۡ بِذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۚ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَظُنُّوۡنَ
And they say, “There is no life but our worldly life. We die and live, and nothing destroys us except time.” They have no knowledge about that; they do nothing but make conjectures.
وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوا ائۡتُوۡا بِاٰبَآئِنَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, their argument is none but that they say, “Bring our fathers, if you are truthful.”
قُلِ اللّٰهُ يُحۡيِيۡكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيۡتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
Say, “Allah gives you life, then makes you die, then He will assemble you on the Day of Judgement in which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know.
وَلِلّٰهِ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّخۡسَرُ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَ
To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. The day the Hour will take place, it will be the day in which the adherents of falsehood shall lose,
وَتَرٰي كُلَّ اُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةًؕࣞ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍ تُدۡعٰ٘ي اِلٰي كِتٰبِهَاؕ اَلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
and you will see every community kneeling down. Every community will be called to its book (of record). Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
هٰذَا كِتٰبُنَا يَنۡطِقُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡتَنۡسِخُ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
This is Our book that speaks against you with truth. We used to get recorded all that you used to do.
فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
Then, as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them to His mercy. That is indeed the achievement, visible to all.
وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاࣞ اَفَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ اٰيٰتِيۡ تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَ
And as to those who disbelieved, (it will be said to them,) “Had My verses not been recited to you? But you showed arrogance, and you were a guilty people;
وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهَا قُلۡتُمۡ مَّا نَدۡرِيۡ مَا السَّاعَةُۙ اِنۡ نَّظُنُّ اِلَّا ظَنًّا وَّمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُسۡتَيۡقِنِيۡنَ

and when it was said to you that Allah’s promise is true and there is no doubt in the (arrival of the) Hour, you used to say, ‘We do not know what the Hour is. We do not think (about it) but as an assumption, and we are not sure.’”
وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
And revealed to them will be the evils of what they did, and encircled they will be by what they used to ridicule.
وَقِيۡلَ الۡيَوۡمَ نَنۡسٰىكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيۡتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هٰذَا وَمَاۡوٰىكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَ
It will be said, “Today We will forget you, as you forgot facing this your day, and your abode is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers at all.
ذٰلِكُمۡ بِاَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذۡتُمۡ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ هُزُوًا وَّغَرَّتۡكُمُ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَاۚ فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُوۡنَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُوۡنَ
That is because you took Allah’s verses as a laughing stock, and the worldly life deceived you.” So today they will neither be brought out of it, nor will they be asked to repent.
فَلِلّٰهِ الۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَرَبِّ الۡاَرۡضِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
So, to Allah belongs all praise, who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the worlds.
وَلَهُ الۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُࣖ‏
And to Him belongs majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.
46: Hā Mīm .
تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ
This is revelation of the book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
مَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا٘ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا عَمَّا٘ اُنۡذِرُوۡا مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ
We did not create the heavens and the earth but with true purpose and for a specified term. But those who disbelieve are averse to what they are warned of.

قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ مَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَرُوۡنِيۡ مَاذَا خَلَقُوۡا مِنَ الۡاَرۡضِ اَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكٌ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِؕ اِيۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِكِتٰبٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِ هٰذَا٘ اَوۡ اَثٰرَةٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمٍ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ

Say, “Tell me about those whom you invoke instead of Allah, (and) show me what they have created from the earth; Or have they a share in (the creation of) the heavens? Bring to me a book (revealed) before this one, or a trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.”
وَمَنۡ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنۡ يَّدۡعُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَنۡ لَّا يَسۡتَجِيۡبُ لَهٗ٘ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَهُمۡ عَنۡ دُعَآئِهِمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ
Who is more astray than him who invokes, instead of Allah, those who will not respond to him up to the Day of Judgement; and they are totally unaware of their prayers,
وَاِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوۡا لَهُمۡ اَعۡدَآءً وَّكَانُوۡا بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ كٰفِرِيۡنَ
and when people will be assembled (on the Day of Judgment), they will be enemies to them, and will refuse even their having worshipped them.
وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۙ هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌؕ‏
When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say about the truth when it comes to them, “This is an open magic.”

اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰىهُؕ قُلۡ اِنِ افۡتَرَيۡتُهٗ فَلَا تَمۡلِكُوۡنَ لِيۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ شَيۡـًٔاؕ هُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيۡضُوۡنَ فِيۡهِؕ كَفٰي بِهٖ شَهِيۡدًاۭ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَكُمۡؕ وَهُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ

Is it that they say, “He has forged it (the Qur’ān)”? Say, “If I have forged it, then you do not have any power to help me against Allah. He is well aware of what you are engaged in. He is enough as a witness between me and you, and He is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.”
قُلۡ مَا كُنۡتُ بِدۡعًا مِّنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا٘ اَدۡرِيۡ مَا يُفۡعَلُ بِيۡ وَلَا بِكُمۡؕ اِنۡ اَتَّبِعُ اِلَّا مَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ وَمَا٘ اَنَا اِلَّا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
Say, “I am not something unprecedented among the messengers, and I do not know what will be done to me or to you. I do not follow anything but what is revealed to me, and I am only a clear warner.”

قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كَانَ مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ وَكَفَرۡتُمۡ بِهٖ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۭۡ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ عَلٰي مِثۡلِهٖ فَاٰمَنَ وَاسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِي الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏

Say, “Tell me, If it (the Qur’ān) is from Allah and you reject it, and a witness from the children of Isrā’īl testifies about something similar to it and comes to believe (in it), while you persist in your arrogance, (then, how unjust you are!) Surely, Allah does not give guidance to the unjust people.
وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَوۡ كَانَ خَيۡرًا مَّا سَبَقُوۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِؕ وَاِذۡ لَمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡا بِهٖ فَسَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ هٰذَا٘ اِفۡكٌ قَدِيۡمٌ

The disbelievers say about the believers, “Had it (Islamic faith) been a good thing, these (weak and poor) people would not have preceded us (in proceeding) towards it.” Since they did not accept guidance through it (the Qur’ān), they will say, “This is a classical lie.”
وَمِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ كِتٰبُ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِمَامًا وَّرَحۡمَةًؕ وَهٰذَا كِتٰبٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّيُنۡذِرَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡاࣗۖ وَبُشۡرٰي لِلۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ

And before this there was the Book of Mūsā, a guide and a mercy. And this is a Book confirming (it) in Arabic tongue, so that it may warn the wrongdoers and give good news to those who are good in their deeds.
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا اللّٰهُ ثُمَّ اسۡتَقَامُوۡا فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُوۡنَۚ‏
Surely, those who say, “Our Lord is Allah” and then stay firm, they will have no fear, nor shall they grieve.
اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۚ جَزَآءًۭ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
Those are the people of Paradise, who will live there for ever as a reward for what they used to do.

وَوَصَّيۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ بِوَالِدَيۡهِ اِحۡسٰنًاؕ حَمَلَتۡهُ اُمُّهٗ كُرۡهًا وَّوَضَعَتۡهُ كُرۡهًاؕ وَحَمۡلُهٗ وَفِصٰلُهٗ ثَلٰثُوۡنَ شَهۡرًاؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ وَبَلَغَ اَرۡبَعِيۡنَ سَنَةًۙ قَالَ رَبِّ اَوۡزِعۡنِيۡ٘ اَنۡ اَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلٰي وَالِدَيَّ وَاَنۡ اَعۡمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرۡضٰىهُ وَاَصۡلِحۡ لِيۡ فِيۡ ذُرِّيَّتِيۡۚؕ اِنِّيۡ تُبۡتُ اِلَيۡكَ وَاِنِّيۡ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ

And We have enjoined upon man to do good to his parents. His mother carried him with difficulty and delivered him with difficulty. And his carrying and his weaning is (in) thirty months, until when he attains his maturity and reaches forty years, he says, “My Lord, grant me that I offer gratitude for the favour You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and that I do righteous deeds that You like. And set righteousness, for my sake, in my progeny. Of course, I repent to you, and truly I am one of those who submit to You.”
اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنۡهُمۡ اَحۡسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوۡا وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَنۡ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ فِيۡ٘ اَصۡحٰبِ الۡجَنَّةِؕ وَعۡدَ الصِّدۡقِ الَّذِيۡ كَانُوۡا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ

Such are the people from whom We accept the best of what they did, and overlook their evil deeds, (so as they will be) among the people of Paradise according to the true promise that was made to them.

وَالَّذِيۡ قَالَ لِوَالِدَيۡهِ اُفٍّ لَّكُمَا٘ اَتَعِدٰنِنِيۡ٘ اَنۡ اُخۡرَجَ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ الۡقُرُوۡنُ مِنۡ قَبۡلِيۡۚ وَهُمَا يَسۡتَغِيۡثٰنِ اللّٰهَ وَيۡلَكَ اٰمِنۡࣗۖ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّۚ فَيَقُوۡلُ مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ

And (Contrary to this is the case of) the one who said to his parents, “Fie upon you both! Do you promise to me that I shall be brought out (from the grave), while generations have passed before me?” And they (the parents) were crying for Allah’s help, (and saying to their son,) “Woe to you. Accept the true faith. Allah’s promise is certainly true.” Then he says, “This is nothing but the tales of the ancients.”
اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقَوۡلُ فِيۡ٘ اُمَمٍ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا خٰسِرِيۡنَ
Such are the people on whom the word (of punishment) has come true along with the communities of the Jinn and the humans that have passed before them. Surely they were losers.
وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوۡاۚ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمۡ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
For each (of these two groups) there are (different) ranks because of what they did, and so that He may repay them in full for their deeds; and they will not be wronged.

وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا عَلَي النَّارِؕ اَذۡهَبۡتُمۡ طَيِّبٰتِكُمۡ فِيۡ حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنۡيَا وَاسۡتَمۡتَعۡتُمۡ بِهَاۚ فَالۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ الۡهُوۡنِ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَفۡسُقُوۡنَࣖ‏

And the day the disbelievers will be presented before the Fire, (it will be said to them,) “You have consumed your good things in your worldly life, and have enjoyed them. So, you will be punished today with the torment of humiliation for the arrogance you used to show on earth with no right (to do so), and for the sins you used to commit.

وَاذۡكُرۡ اَخَا عَادٍ اِذۡ اَنۡذَرَ قَوۡمَهٗ بِالۡاَحۡقَافِ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهٖ٘ اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا اللّٰهَؕ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ

And recall the brother of (the nation of) ‘Ād, when he warned his people at the long, curved sand dunes- while many warners have passed before him and after him (with the same message)-saying, “Do not worship anyone except Allah. Surely I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day.”
قَالُوۡ٘ا اَجِئۡتَنَا لِتَاۡفِكَنَا عَنۡ اٰلِهَتِنَاۚ فَاۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
They said, “Have you come to make us deviate from our gods? So bring us that with which you are threatening us, if you are truthful.”
قَالَ اِنَّمَا الۡعِلۡمُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِؗ وَاُبَلِّغُكُمۡ مَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهٖ وَلٰكِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىكُمۡ قَوۡمًا تَجۡهَلُوۡنَ
He said, “The knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am conveying to you what I am sent with, but I see you are a people who act ignorantly.”
فَلَمَّا رَاَوۡهُ عَارِضًا مُّسۡتَقۡبِلَ اَوۡدِيَتِهِمۡۙ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمۡطِرُنَاؕ بَلۡ هُوَ مَا اسۡتَعۡجَلۡتُمۡ بِهٖؕ رِيۡحٌ فِيۡهَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌۙ‏

So, when they saw it as a cloud proceeding towards their valleys, they said, “This is a cloud that will bring us rain.” No, it is the very thing you asked to hasten up - a wind in which there is a painful punishment,
تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍۭ بِاَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا لَا يُرٰ٘ي اِلَّا مَسٰكِنُهُمۡؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الۡقَوۡمَ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
that will destroy every thing with the command of its Lord! So they became such that nothing remained to be seen except their dwelling places. This is how We punish the guilty people.

وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنّٰهُمۡ فِيۡمَا٘ اِنۡ مَّكَّنّٰكُمۡ فِيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ سَمۡعًا وَّاَبۡصَارًا وَّاَفۡـِٕدَةًؗۖ فَمَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَبۡصَارُهُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَفۡـِٕدَتُهُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ اِذۡ كَانُوۡا يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَࣖ‏

And indeed We had established them in a powerful position in which We did not establish you (O people of Makkah), and had given to them ears and eyes and hearts, but neither their ears benefited them in the least, nor their eyes, nor their hearts, as they used to reject Allah’s signs; and they were encircled by what they used to ridicule.
وَلَقَدۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مَا حَوۡلَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرٰي وَصَرَّفۡنَا الۡاٰيٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
And We have (also) destroyed (other) towns around you, while We had given to them a variety of signs, so that they might return (from disbelief).
فَلَوۡلَا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ قُرۡبَانًا اٰلِهَةًؕ بَلۡ ضَلُّوۡا عَنۡهُمۡۚ وَذٰلِكَ اِفۡكُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ

So, why is it that they were not helped by those whom they had taken as gods beside Allah in order to attain closeness (to Him)? Instead, they vanished from them. That was, in fact, their falsity and a thing they used to fabricate.
وَاِذۡ صَرَفۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ يَسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَۚ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوۡهُ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَنۡصِتُوۡاۚ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوۡا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهِمۡ مُّنۡذِرِيۡنَ

And (recall) when We directed a group of Jinns towards you, listening to the Qur’ān. So, when they attended it, they said (to each other), “Keep quiet.” Then once it was over, they went back to their people as warners.
قَالُوۡا يٰقَوۡمَنَا٘ اِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا كِتٰبًا اُنۡزِلَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مُوۡسٰي مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ يَهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلَي الۡحَقِّ وَاِلٰي طَرِيۡقٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
They said, “O our people, we have heard a book sent down after Mūsā, confirming what was before it, which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
يٰقَوۡمَنَا٘ اَجِيۡبُوۡا دَاعِيَ اللّٰهِ وَاٰمِنُوۡا بِهٖ يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذُنُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُجِرۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
O our people, respond to Allah’s herald, and believe in him, and (once you do that,) Allah will forgive your sins for you, and will save you from a painful punishment.
وَمَنۡ لَّا يُجِبۡ دَاعِيَ اللّٰهِ فَلَيۡسَ بِمُعۡجِزٍ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَيۡسَ لَهٗ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءُؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
The one who does not respond to Allah’s herald is not (able) to frustrate (Allah by escaping) in the land, and for him there are no supporters besides Him. Such people are in open error.
اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَلَمۡ يَعۡيَ بِخَلۡقِهِنَّ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ يُّحۡيِۦَ الۡمَوۡتٰيؕ بَلٰ٘ي اِنَّهٗ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ

Have they not seen that Allah who has created the heavens and the earth, and was not wearied by their creation, does have power to give life to the dead? Yes of course, He is powerful to do every thing.
وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا عَلَي النَّارِؕ اَلَيۡسَ هٰذَا بِالۡحَقِّؕ قَالُوۡا بَلٰي وَرَبِّنَاؕ قَالَ فَذُوۡقُوا الۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ

The day the disbelievers will be presented to the Fire, (it will be said to them,) “Is this not true?” They will say, “Yes of course, Our Lord!” He will say, “Then taste the punishment, for you used to disbelieve.”

فَاصۡبِرۡ كَمَا صَبَرَ اُولُوا الۡعَزۡمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلۡ لَّهُمۡؕ كَاَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَۙ لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّنۡ نَّهَارٍؕ بَلٰغٌۚ فَهَلۡ يُهۡلَكُ اِلَّا الۡقَوۡمُ الۡفٰسِقُوۡنَࣖ‏

So, (O prophet,) observe patience, as the resolute messengers observed patience, and be not in haste about them. The Day they will see what they are promised, (it will be) as if they did not stay (in the world) more than an hour in a single day. This is a message. So, none will be destroyed except the sinners.
47: اَلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ اَضَلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
Those who disbelieved, and prevented (others) from Allah’s way, He (Allah) has rendered their deeds vain.
وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَاٰمَنُوۡا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلٰي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّهُوَ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡۙ كَفَّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ وَاَصۡلَحَ بَالَهُمۡ‏

And those who believed and did righteous deeds and believed in that which is revealed to MuHammad,-and it is the truth (that has come) from their Lord-He will write off their evil deeds, and will set aright their state of affairs.
ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الۡبَاطِلَ وَاَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الۡحَقَّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ اللّٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ اَمۡثَالَهُمۡ‏

That is because the disbelievers have followed falsehood, while the believers have followed the truth (that has come) from their Lord. This is how Allah explains their (respective) situations to the people.

فَاِذَا لَقِيۡتُمُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَضَرۡبَ الرِّقَابِؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَثۡخَنۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ فَشُدُّوا الۡوَثَاقَۙ فَاِمَّا مَنًّاۭ بَعۡدُ وَاِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتّٰي تَضَعَ الۡحَرۡبُ اَوۡزَارَهَا ࣢ۚࣞۛ ذٰلِكَؕۛ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ لَانۡتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡۙ وَلٰكِنۡ لِّيَبۡلُوَا۠ بَعۡضَكُمۡ بِبَعۡضٍؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ قُتِلُوۡا فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ فَلَنۡ يُّضِلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏

So, when you encounter those who disbelieve, then (aim at) smiting the necks, until when you have broken their strength thoroughly, then tie fast the bond, (by making them captives). Then choose (to release them) either (as) a favour (shown to them,), or (after receiving) ransom,until the war throws down its load of arms. That (is Our command.) If Allah willed, He would have (Himself) subjected them to retribution, but (Allah ordered you to fight,) so that He may test some of you through some others. And those who are killed in Allah’s way, He will never let their deeds go to waste.
سَيَهۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَيُصۡلِحُ بَالَهُمۡۚ‏
(Instead,) He will guide them, and will set aright their state of affairs,
وَيُدۡخِلُهُمُ الۡجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمۡ‏
and will admit them to the Paradise He has identified for them.
يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ تَنۡصُرُوا اللّٰهَ يَنۡصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَكُمۡ‏
O you who believe, if you will help (the religion prescribed by) Allah, He will help you, and will stabilize your footings.
وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَتَعۡسًا لَّهُمۡ وَاَضَلَّ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
As for those who disbelieve, (destined) for them is destruction, and He has rendered their deeds vain.
ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَرِهُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ فَاَحۡبَطَ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‏
That is because they hate what Allah has sent down; therefore Allah has nullified their deeds.
اَفَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ دَمَّرَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡؗ وَلِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اَمۡثَالُهَا
Have they not travelled in the land so that they might see how was the end of those before them? Allah brought utter destruction to them. And (ready) for (these) disbelievers are the likes thereof.
ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَوۡلَي الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاَنَّ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ لَا مَوۡلٰي لَهُمۡࣖ‏
That is because Allah is the supporter of those who believe. As for the disbelievers, there is no supporter for them.

اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُدۡخِلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يَتَمَتَّعُوۡنَ وَيَاۡكُلُوۡنَ كَمَا تَاۡكُلُ الۡاَنۡعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثۡوًي لَّهُمۡ‏

Surely, Allah will admit those who believe and do good deeds to the gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy (the worldly life), and eat as cattle eat, and the Fire is the final abode for them.
وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ هِيَ اَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّنۡ قَرۡيَتِكَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَخۡرَجَتۡكَۚ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمۡ‏
How many a town, stronger in might than your town that has expelled you, have We destroyed! Then, there was none to help them.
اَفَمَنۡ كَانَ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ كَمَنۡ زُيِّنَ لَهٗ سُوۡٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ‏
Then, can one who holds on to a clear proof from his Lord be like those for whom their evil deeds are beautified, and who followed their desires?

مَثَلُ الۡجَنَّةِ الَّتِيۡ وُعِدَ الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَؕ فِيۡهَا٘ اَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ اٰسِنٍۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ لَّبَنٍ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهٗۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ خَمۡرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشّٰرِبِيۡنَ ࣢ۚ وَاَنۡهٰرٌ مِّنۡ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّيؕ وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡؕ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوۡا مَآءً حَمِيۡمًا فَقَطَّعَ اَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ‏

(Here is) a description of the Paradise that is promised for the God-fearing! In it there are rivers of water, never spoiling, and rivers of milk the taste of which would not go bad, and rivers of wine, delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of honey, fully purified. And for them there are all sorts of fruits, and forgiveness from their Lord. Are they like those who will live in Fire forever, and will be given boiling water to drink, and it will tear their bowels into pieces?

وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّسۡتَمِعُ اِلَيۡكَۚ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا خَرَجُوۡا مِنۡ عِنۡدِكَ قَالُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ مَاذَا قَالَ اٰنِفًاࣞ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ‏

Among them there are ones who (pretend to) give ear to you, until when they go out from your presence, they say to those who have been given knowledge, “What did he say just now?” Those are the ones on whose hearts Allah has put a seal, and they have followed their desires.
وَالَّذِيۡنَ اهۡتَدَوۡا زَادَهُمۡ هُدًي وَّاٰتٰىهُمۡ تَقۡوٰىهُمۡ‏
As for those who have adopted right path, Allah improves them in guidance, and gives them their piety.
فَهَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَغۡتَةًۚ فَقَدۡ جَآءَ اَشۡرَاطُهَاۚ فَاَنّٰي لَهُمۡ اِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ذِكۡرٰىهُمۡ‏

They are waiting for nothing but for the Hour (of Doom) that it should come upon them suddenly. So, its signs have already come. Then, once it will come upon them, how would they have an opportunity to accept the advice (already) given to them?
فَاعۡلَمۡ اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۭۡ بِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوٰىكُمۡࣖ‏

So, be assured that there is no god but Allah, and seek forgiveness for your fault, and for (the faults of) the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows your moving from place to place and your permanent abode.

وَيَقُوۡلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَتۡ سُوۡرَةٌۚ فَاِذَا٘ اُنۡزِلَتۡ سُوۡرَةٌ مُّحۡكَمَةٌ وَّذُكِرَ فِيۡهَا الۡقِتَالُۙ رَاَيۡتَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌ يَّنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكَ نَظَرَ الۡمَغۡشِيِّ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ الۡمَوۡتِؕ فَاَوۡلٰي لَهُمۡۚ‏

And the believers say, “Why has a (new) Sūrah not been revealed?” Then, once an operative Sūrah is sent down, and fighting (in Allah’s way) is mentioned in it, you notice those who have disease in their hearts, looking to you like one who is faint because of death. So, destruction is very close to them.
طَاعَةٌ وَّقَوۡلٌ مَّعۡرُوۡفٌࣞ فَاِذَا عَزَمَ الۡاَمۡرُࣞ فَلَوۡ صَدَقُوا اللّٰهَ لَكَانَ خَيۡرًا لَّهُمۡۚ‏

The (reality of their) obedience and (truthfulness of their) speech is fully known (as being mere deception). So, had they been truthful to Allah when the matter had become serious, it would have been much better for them.
فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ اَنۡ تُفۡسِدُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوۡ٘ا اَرۡحَامَكُمۡ‏
So, (O hypocrites,) do you not apprehend that, in case you turn away (from Jihād ), you will spread disorder in the land and will sever your ties of kinship?
اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فَاَصَمَّهُمۡ وَاَعۡمٰ٘ي اَبۡصَارَهُمۡ‏
Those are the ones whom Allah has cursed; so He has made them deaf, and made their eyes blind.
اَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُوۡنَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ اَمۡ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبٍ اَقۡفَالُهَا
Then, do they not give serious thought to the Qur’ān, or do they have locks on their hearts?
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ ارۡتَدُّوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اَدۡبَارِهِمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الۡهُدَيۙ الشَّيۡطٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمۡؕ وَاَمۡلٰي لَهُمۡ‏
Surely those who turn back after the guidance has appeared to them clearly, it is Satan who has tempted them and involved them in far-fetched fancies.
ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ قَالُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ كَرِهُوۡا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ سَنُطِيۡعُكُمۡ فِيۡ بَعۡضِ الۡاَمۡرِۚ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ اِسۡرَارَهُمۡ‏
That is because they say to those who hate that which Allah has revealed, “We will obey you in some respects.” And Allah knows their secret talk.
فَكَيۡفَ اِذَا تَوَفَّتۡهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُوۡنَ وُجُوۡهَهُمۡ وَاَدۡبَارَهُمۡ‏
So, how (miserable) will they be when the angels will exact their souls, smiting their faces and their backs?
