اِنِّيۡ ظَنَنۡتُ اَنِّيۡ مُلٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهۡۚ‏
I was sure that I would encounter my reckoning.”
فَهُوَ فِيۡ عِيۡشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍۙ‏
So he will be in a well-pleasing life
فِيۡ جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۙ‏
in a lofty garden,
قُطُوۡفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
the fruits of which will be close at hand.
كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَنِيۡٓـًٔاۭ بِمَا٘ اَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي الۡاَيَّامِ الۡخَالِيَةِ
(It will be said to such people,) “Eat and drink with pleasure, as a reward for what you did in advance during past days.”
وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِشِمَالِهٖ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ لَمۡ اُوۡتَ كِتٰبِيَهۡۚ‏
As for him who will be given his book in his left hand, he will say, “ Oh, would that I had not been given my book,
وَلَمۡ اَدۡرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهۡۚ‏
and I had never known what my account is!
يٰلَيۡتَهَا كَانَتِ الۡقَاضِيَةَۚ‏
Oh, would that it (death) had been the end of the matter!
مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنِّيۡ مَالِيَهۡۚ‏
My wealth has not been of any use to me.
هَلَكَ عَنِّيۡ سُلۡطٰنِيَهۡۚ‏
My power has gone from me for good.”
خُذُوۡهُ فَغُلُّوۡهُۙ‏
(Then it will be said to angels,) “Seize him, then put a collar around his neck,
ثُمَّ الۡجَحِيۡمَ صَلُّوۡهُۙ‏
and then, let him burn in the blazing fire.
ثُمَّ فِيۡ سِلۡسِلَةٍ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُوۡنَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسۡلُكُوۡهُؕ‏
Thereafter, fasten him with a chain the measure of which is seventy hands.”
اِنَّهٗ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۙ‏
Indeed, he did not believe in Allah, the Almighty,
وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلٰي طَعَامِ الۡمِسۡكِيۡنِؕ‏
and did not persuade (others) to feed the needy.
فَلَيۡسَ لَهُ الۡيَوۡمَ هٰهُنَا حَمِيۡمٌۙ‏
So, he has no friend here today,
وَّلَا طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِنۡ غِسۡلِيۡنٍۙ‏
nor any food except that which comes out from wounds when washing,
لَّا يَاۡكُلُهٗ٘ اِلَّا الۡخٰطِـُٔوۡنَࣖ‏
which is eaten by none but the sinners.
فَلَا٘ اُقۡسِمُ بِمَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَۙ‏
I swear by what you see,
وَمَا لَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَۙ‏
and what you do not see,
اِنَّهٗ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُوۡلٍ كَرِيۡمٍۚۙ‏
it is surely the speech of a noble Messenger, (that he conveys from Allah).
وَّمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرٍؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
and it is not the speech of a poet, (but) little you believe,
وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنٍؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَؕ‏
nor is it the speech of a soothsayer, (but) little you heed to the advice.
تَنۡزِيۡلٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
وَلَوۡ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيۡنَا بَعۡضَ الۡاَقَاوِيۡلِۙ‏
Had he (the prophet) forged some statements in Our name,
لَاَخَذۡنَا مِنۡهُ بِالۡيَمِيۡنِۙ‏
We would have certainly seized him by the right hand,
ثُمَّ لَقَطَعۡنَا مِنۡهُ الۡوَتِيۡنَؗۖ‏
and then severed his life-artery,
فَمَا مِنۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حٰجِزِيۡنَ
and none of you could have saved him from it.
وَاِنَّهٗ لَتَذۡكِرَةٌ لِّلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ
It is infact a Reminder for the God-fearing.
وَاِنَّا لَنَعۡلَمُ اَنَّ مِنۡكُمۡ مُّكَذِّبِيۡنَ
And, of course, We know that among you there are deniers.
وَاِنَّهٗ لَحَسۡرَةٌ عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
And surely, it is a cause of remorse for the disbelievers.
وَاِنَّهٗ لَحَقُّ الۡيَقِيۡنِ
And it is surely an absolute truth.
فَسَبِّحۡ بِاسۡمِ رَبِّكَ الۡعَظِيۡمِࣖ‏
So, pronounce the purity of the name of your magnificent Lord.
70: سَاَلَ سَآئِلٌۭ بِعَذَابٍ وَّاقِعٍۙ‏
A demanding person has asked for the punishment that is going to befall
لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ لَيۡسَ لَهٗ دَافِعٌۙ‏
the disbelievers; there is no one to avert it,
مِّنَ اللّٰهِ ذِي الۡمَعَارِجِؕ‏
(and it will come) from Allah, the Lord of the stairways,
تَعۡرُجُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَالرُّوۡحُ اِلَيۡهِ فِيۡ يَوۡمٍ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهٗ خَمۡسِيۡنَ اَلۡفَ سَنَةٍۚ‏
to whom ascend the angels and the Spirit in a day the length of which is fifty thousand years.
فَاصۡبِرۡ صَبۡرًا جَمِيۡلًا
So, observe patience, a good patience.
اِنَّهُمۡ يَرَوۡنَهٗ بَعِيۡدًاۙ‏
They see it far off,
وَّنَرٰىهُ قَرِيۡبًاؕ‏
and We see it near.
يَوۡمَ تَكُوۡنُ السَّمَآءُ كَالۡمُهۡلِۙ‏
(This punishment will befall) on the Day when the sky will be like dregs of oil,
وَتَكُوۡنُ الۡجِبَالُ كَالۡعِهۡنِۙ‏
and the mountains will be like dyed wool,
وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلُ حَمِيۡمٌ حَمِيۡمًاۚۙ‏
and no friend will ask about any friend,
يُّبَصَّرُوۡنَهُمۡؕ يَوَدُّ الۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِيۡ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيۡهِۙ‏
(though) they will be made to see each other. A guilty person will desire that he may be able to ransom himself from the torment of that day even by his sons,
وَصَاحِبَتِهٖ وَاَخِيۡهِۙ‏
and his wife and his brother,
وَفَصِيۡلَتِهِ الَّتِيۡ تُـٔۡوِيۡهِۙ‏
and his kindred that sheltered him,
وَمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًاۙ ثُمَّ يُنۡجِيۡهِۙ‏
and all those on earth, then he may redeem himself.
كَلَّاؕ اِنَّهَا لَظٰيۙ‏
By no means! It is the flaming fire
نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوٰيۚۖ‏
that will pull out the skin of the scalp.
تَدۡعُوۡا مَنۡ اَدۡبَرَ وَتَوَلّٰيۙ‏
It will call him who had turned his back and fled away (from the truth)
وَجَمَعَ فَاَوۡعٰي
and accumulated (wealth) and hoarded (it).
اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوۡعًاۙ‏
Indeed man is created weak in courage,
اِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوۡعًاۙ‏
very upset when touched by evil,
وَّاِذَا مَسَّهُ الۡخَيۡرُ مَنُوۡعًاۙ‏
and very niggard when visited by good (fortune),
اِلَّا الۡمُصَلِّيۡنَۙ‏
except the performers of Salāh,
الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَلٰي صَلَاتِهِمۡ دَآئِمُوۡنَۙࣕ‏
who are regular in their Salāh,
وَالَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡوَالِهِمۡ حَقٌّ مَّعۡلُوۡمٌۙࣕ‏
and those in whose riches there is a specified right
لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَالۡمَحۡرُوۡمِۙࣕ‏
for the one who asks and the one who is deprived,
وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُصَدِّقُوۡنَ بِيَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِۙࣕ‏
and those who believe in the Day of Judgment as true,
وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمۡ مُّشۡفِقُوۡنَۚ‏
and those who are fearful of the torment of their Lord-
اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمۡ غَيۡرُ مَاۡمُوۡنٍࣕ‏
-Indeed the torment of their Lord is not something to be fearless from.-
وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوۡجِهِمۡ حٰفِظُوۡنَۙ‏
and those who guard their private parts,
اِلَّا عَلٰ٘ي اَزۡوَاجِهِمۡ اَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُهُمۡ فَاِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُوۡمِيۡنَۚ‏
except from their wives and those (slave-girls) owned by their hands,- because they are not to be blamed,
فَمَنِ ابۡتَغٰي وَرَآءَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡعٰدُوۡنَۚ‏
but the one who seeks (sexual gratification) beyond that, then such people are the transgressors,-
وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رٰعُوۡنَࣕۙ‏
and those who are careful about their trusts and covenants,
وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِشَهٰدٰتِهِمۡ قَآئِمُوۡنَۙࣕ‏
and those who are upright in their testimonies,
وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَلٰي صَلَاتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُوۡنَؕ‏
and those who take due care of their Salāh .
اُولٰٓئِكَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ مُّكۡرَمُوۡنَࣖؕ‏
Those will be honoured in gardens (of Jannah ).
فَمَالِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا قِبَلَكَ مُهۡطِعِيۡنَۙ‏
So what has happened to those who disbelieve that they are rushing towards you
عَنِ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِيۡنَ
from the right and from the left, in groups?
اَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ امۡرِئٍ مِّنۡهُمۡ اَنۡ يُّدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيۡمٍۙ‏
Does every one of them aspire to be admitted to the garden of bliss?
كَلَّاؕ اِنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُمۡ مِّمَّا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
By no means! We have created them from what they know.
فَلَا٘ اُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ الۡمَشٰرِقِ وَالۡمَغٰرِبِ اِنَّا لَقٰدِرُوۡنَۙ‏
So, I swear by the Lord of the points of sunrise and those of sunset, We are powerful
عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهُمۡۙ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوۡقِيۡنَ
to bring those better than them in their place, and We are not to be frustrated.
فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوۡضُوۡا وَيَلۡعَبُوۡا حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِيۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَۙ‏
So, leave them involved in pastime and play until they encounter their Day, which they are promised,
يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَاَنَّهُمۡ اِلٰي نُصُبٍ يُّوۡفِضُوۡنَۙ‏
the Day they will come out of the graves quickly, as if they were rushing toward idols,
خَاشِعَةً اَبۡصَارُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٌؕ ذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمُ الَّذِيۡ كَانُوۡا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَࣖ‏
with their eyes downcast, enveloped by ignominy. That is the Day, which they were being promised.
71: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اَنۡ اَنۡذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
We sent NūH to his people (and said to him): “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
He said, “O my people, I openly warn you
اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوۡهُ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِۙ‏
that you must worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me,
يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذُنُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۘ لَوۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
and Allah will forgive you your sins, and will respite you to an appointed term. Indeed when Allah’s term comes, it is not deferred, if you only know!”
قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِيۡ لَيۡلًا وَّنَهَارًاۙ‏
He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيۡ٘ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
but my call added only to their flight (from the truth).
وَاِنِّيۡ كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوۡ٘ا اَصَابِعَهُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَاسۡتَغۡشَوۡا ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَاَصَرُّوۡا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوا اسۡتِكۡبَارًاۚ‏
Whenever I called them, so that You might forgive them, they put their fingers into their ears, and wrapped their clothes around themselves, and grew obstinate, and waxed proud in extreme arrogance.
ثُمَّ اِنِّيۡ دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارًاۙ‏
Then I called them loudly,
ثُمَّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَنۡتُ لَهُمۡ وَاَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ اِسۡرَارًاۙ‏
and then I spoke to them in public and spoke to them in private.
فَقُلۡتُ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡࣞ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًاۙ‏
So I said, ‘Pray to your Lord for your forgiveness,- Indeed He is Very-Forgiving, -
يُّرۡسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّدۡرَارًاۙ‏
and He will cause the heavens to rain upon you in abundance,
وَّيُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ بِاَمۡوَالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَ وَيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ اَنۡهٰرًاؕ‏
and will help you with riches and sons, and will cause gardens to grow for you, and cause rivers to flow for you.
مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًاۚ‏
What has happened to you that you do not appreciate the Majesty of Allah,
وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ اَطۡوَارًا
while He has created you in different phases?
اَلَمۡ تَرَوۡا كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۙ‏
Did you not see how Allah has created seven heavens one upon another,
وَّجَعَلَ الۡقَمَرَ فِيۡهِنَّ نُوۡرًا وَّجَعَلَ الشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجًا
and has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
وَاللّٰهُ اَنۭۡ بَتَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ نَبَاتًاۙ‏
And Allah has caused you to grow well out of the earth,
ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُكُمۡ فِيۡهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ اِخۡرَاجًا
then He will send you back into it, and will bring you forth once again.
وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ بِسَاطًاۙ‏
And Allah has made the earth a spread for you,
لِّتَسۡلُكُوۡا مِنۡهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًاࣖ‏
so that you may go about its broad ways.’”
قَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِيۡ وَاتَّبَعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَوَلَدُهٗ٘ اِلَّا خَسَارًاۚ‏
And said NūH, “My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed him whose wealth and children added nothing to him but loss,
وَمَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرًا كُبَّارًاۚ‏
and they devised a mighty plot,
وَقَالُوۡا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّلَا سُوَاعًا ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَغُوۡثَ وَيَعُوۡقَ وَنَسۡرًاۚ‏
and said (to their people), “Never forsake your gods, and never forsake Wadd, nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr.
وَقَدۡ اَضَلُّوۡا كَثِيۡرًا ࣢ۚ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلًا
And they have led many astray. And (O my Lord,) let not the wrongdoers progress in anything but deviation from the right path.”
مِمَّا خَطِيۡٓـٰٔتِهِمۡ اُغۡرِقُوۡا فَاُدۡخِلُوۡا نَارًا ࣢ۙ فَلَمۡ يَجِدُوۡا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَنۡصَارًا
Because of their sins they were drowned, and then admitted into the Fire. So they found no helpers for them besides Allah.
وَقَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَي الۡاَرۡضِ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ دَيَّارًا
And said NūH, “My Lord, do not leave on earth even a single inhabitant (surviving) out of the disbelievers.
اِنَّكَ اِنۡ تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّوۡا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
If You leave them (surviving), they will lead Your servants astray, and will beget none but a sinful disbeliever.
رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنۡ دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنًا وَّلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِؕ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًاࣖ‏
My Lord, grant pardon to me, and to my parents, and to everyone who enters my home as a believer, and to all the believing men and believing women, and do not increase the wrongdoers but in ruin.
72: قُلۡ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيَّ اَنَّهُ اسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡاٰنًا عَجَبًاۙ‏
Say, “It has been revealed to me that a group from Jinn has listened (to the Qur’ān), and said (to their people), ‘Indeed we have heard an amazing Recital (Qur’ān)
يَّهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلَي الرُّشۡدِ فَاٰمَنَّا بِهٖؕ وَلَنۡ نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا٘ اَحَدًاۙ‏
that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate a partner with our Lord.’
وَّاَنَّهٗ تَعٰلٰي جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًاۙ‏
and (then the Jinns started talking to each other) that exalted is the Glory of our Lord; He has taken neither a wife, nor a son,
وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ يَقُوۡلُ سَفِيۡهُنَا عَلَي اللّٰهِ شَطَطًاۙ‏
and that the fools among us used to attribute to Allah extremely absurd things,
وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّا٘ اَنۡ لَّنۡ تَقُوۡلَ الۡاِنۡسُ وَالۡجِنُّ عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۙ‏
and that we thought that the humans and the Jinn would never tell a lie about Allah, (therefore, we had followed them in shirk under this impression),
وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الۡاِنۡسِ يَعُوۡذُوۡنَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوۡهُمۡ رَهَقًاۙ‏
and that some guys from human beings used to seek refuge with some guys of the Jinn, and thus they increased them (the Jinns) in arrogance,
وَّاَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّوۡا كَمَا ظَنَنۡتُمۡ اَنۡ لَّنۡ يَّبۡعَثَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدًاۙ‏
and that they (humans) thought as you (O Jinns) thought that Allah will never resurrect anyone,
وَّاَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا السَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسًا شَدِيۡدًا وَّشُهُبًاۙ‏
and that we sought (to reach) the sky, but we found it filled with stern guards and flames,
وَّاَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِؕ فَمَنۡ يَّسۡتَمِعِ الۡاٰنَ يَجِدۡ لَهٗ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًاۙ‏
and that we used to sit at places therein to listen; but if one will (try to) listen now, he will find a flame in ambush for him,
وَّاَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيۡ٘ اَشَرٌّ اُرِيۡدَ بِمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اَمۡ اَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدًاۙ‏
and that we do not know whether it is a bad end that is intended for those on earth, or their Lord has intended for them a right thing,
وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحُوۡنَ وَمِنَّا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَؕ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًاۙ‏
and that some of us are (already) righteous, and some of us are otherwise, and we were on different ways;
وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّا٘ اَنۡ لَّنۡ نُّعۡجِزَ اللّٰهَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَنۡ نُّعۡجِزَهٗ هَرَبًاۙ‏
and that we have now believed that we can never frustrate Allah on the earth, nor can we baffle Him by escape,
وَّاَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا الۡهُدٰ٘ي اٰمَنَّا بِهٖؕ فَمَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنۭۡ بِرَبِّهٖ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسًا وَّلَا رَهَقًاۙ‏
and that when we heard the Guiding Discourse, we believed in it; so if one believes in his Lord, he will have no fear of either any curtailment (in his reward) or any excess (in his punishment),
وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الۡمُسۡلِمُوۡنَ وَمِنَّا الۡقٰسِطُوۡنَؕ فَمَنۡ اَسۡلَمَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡا رَشَدًا
and that some of us are Muslims, and some of us are unjust. Now, those who submitted to Islam have found out the right path,
وَاَمَّا الۡقٰسِطُوۡنَ فَكَانُوۡا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًاۙ‏
As for the unjust, they have become firewood for Hell.”
وَّاَنۡ لَّوِ اسۡتَقَامُوۡا عَلَي الطَّرِيۡقَةِ لَاَسۡقَيۡنٰهُمۡ مَّآءً غَدَقًاۙ‏
“(And it is also revealed to me) that if they (the people of Makkah) had stood firm on the (right) way, We would have supplied water to them in abundance,
لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيۡهِؕ وَمَنۡ يُّعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهٖ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًاۙ‏
so that We test them thereby; and if one turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will thrust him into a severe torment,
وَّاَنَّ الۡمَسٰجِدَ لِلّٰهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُوۡا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدًاۙ‏
and that masājid (mosques) belong to Allah; so, do not invoke anyone along with Allah,
وَّاَنَّهٗ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ اللّٰهِ يَدۡعُوۡهُ كَادُوۡا يَكُوۡنُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدًاؕࣖ‏
and that when Allah’s servant stood invoking Him, they almost rushed on him in crowds.”
قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَدۡعُوۡا رَبِّيۡ وَلَا٘ اُشۡرِكُ بِهٖ٘ اَحَدًا
Say, “I invoke my Lord, and do not associate anyone with Him.”
قُلۡ اِنِّيۡ لَا٘ اَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا رَشَدًا
Say, “I possess no power to cause you any harm or bring you to a right way.”
قُلۡ اِنِّيۡ لَنۡ يُّجِيۡرَنِيۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدٌ ࣢ۙ وَّلَنۡ اَجِدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مُلۡتَحَدًاۙ‏
Say, “No one can ever save me from Allah, and I can never find a refuge save with Him.
اِلَّا بَلٰغًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهٖؕ وَمَنۡ يَّعۡصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَبَدًاؕ‏

However, (I have been given power) of conveying (commands) from Allah, and His messages. The one who disobeys Allah and His Messenger, for him there is the fire of Hell, wherein such people will live forever.
حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا رَاَوۡا مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ اَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَّاَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
(The disbelievers will continue denying the truth and mock at it) until when they will see what they are promised, they will know whose supporters are weaker, and whose numbers are less.
قُلۡ اِنۡ اَدۡرِيۡ٘ اَقَرِيۡبٌ مَّا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ اَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهٗ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَمَدًا
Say, “I do not know whether that which you are promised is near, or my Lord has appointed for it a distant term.
عٰلِمُ الۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلٰي غَيۡبِهٖ٘ اَحَدًاۙ‏
(He is the) Knower of the Unseen. So He does not let anyone know the Unseen created by Him,
اِلَّا مَنِ ارۡتَضٰي مِنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ فَاِنَّهٗ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهٖ رَصَدًاۙ‏

except a messenger whom He chooses (to inform through revelation), and then He appoints (angels as) watching guards before him and behind him, (so that devils may not tamper with the divine revelation,)
لِّيَعۡلَمَ اَنۡ قَدۡ اَبۡلَغُوۡا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَاَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَاَحۡصٰي كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدًاࣖ‏
so that He knows that they (angels) have conveyed the messages of their Lord. And He has encompassed all that is with them, and has comprehensive knowledge of every thing by numbers.
73: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمُزَّمِّلُۙ‏
O you, wrapped up in clothes,
قُمِ الَّيۡلَ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًاۙ‏
stand at night (for prayer) except a little-
نِّصۡفَهٗ٘ اَوِ انۡقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيۡلًاۙ‏
-half of it, or make it a little less,
اَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ تَرۡتِيۡلًاؕ‏
or make it a little more; and recite the Qur’ān clearly with tartīl (in a distinct and measured tone).
اِنَّا سَنُلۡقِيۡ عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلًا ثَقِيۡلًا
We are going to send down to you a weighty discourse.
اِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ الَّيۡلِ هِيَ اَشَدُّ وَطۡاً وَّاَقۡوَمُ قِيۡلًاؕ‏
Truly, rising by night (for prayer of tahajjud) is the most effective way to subdue (one’s base self) and to make speech more upright.
اِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبۡحًا طَوِيۡلًاؕ‏
Surely, in daytime, you have a lengthy work to do.
وَاذۡكُرِ اسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ اِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيۡلًاؕ‏
And remember the name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.
رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقِ وَالۡمَغۡرِبِ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيۡلًا
He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He; so take Him for (your) Guardian.
وَاصۡبِرۡ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَاهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرًا جَمِيۡلًا
And bear patiently what they (the opponents) say, and part with them in a beautiful manner.
وَذَرۡنِيۡ وَالۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ اُولِي النَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيۡلًا
And leave Me alone (to deal) with the deniers, the people of luxury, and give them respite for a while.
اِنَّ لَدَيۡنَا٘ اَنۡكَالًا وَّجَحِيۡمًاۙ‏
Surely with Us are fetters and flaming fire,
وَّطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَّعَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًاࣞ‏
and food that chokes, and a painful punishment
يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ الۡاَرۡضُ وَالۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الۡجِبَالُ كَثِيۡبًا مَّهِيۡلًا
on the Day when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will turn into a slipping heap of sand.
اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُوۡلًا ࣢ۙ شَاهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُوۡلًاؕ‏
(O people,) We have sent to you a messenger, as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).
فَعَصٰي فِرۡعَوۡنُ الرَّسُوۡلَ فَاَخَذۡنٰهُ اَخۡذًا وَّبِيۡلًا
Then, Fir‘aun disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a severe seizure.
فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُوۡنَ اِنۡ كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمًا يَّجۡعَلُ الۡوِلۡدَانَ شِيۡبَاۙۖࣗ‏
So, if you disbelieve, how will you save yourself from a day that will turn the small boys into grey-headed old men,
اِۨلسَّمَآءُ مُنۡفَطِرٌۭ بِهٖؕ كَانَ وَعۡدُهٗ مَفۡعُوۡلًا
whereby the sky will burst apart. His promise has to be fulfilled.
اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذۡكِرَةٌۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.

اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ اَنَّكَ تَقُوۡمُ اَدۡنٰي مِنۡ ثُلُثَيِ الَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهٗ وَثُلُثَهٗ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِيۡنَ مَعَكَؕ وَاللّٰهُ يُقَدِّرُ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَؕ عَلِمَ اَنۡ لَّنۡ تُحۡصُوۡهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَاقۡرَءُوۡا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الۡقُرۡاٰنِؕ عَلِمَ اَنۡ سَيَكُوۡنُ مِنۡكُمۡ مَّرۡضٰيۙ وَاٰخَرُوۡنَ يَضۡرِبُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُوۡنَ مِنۡ فَضۡلِ اللّٰهِۙ وَاٰخَرُوۡنَ يُقَاتِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِؗۖ فَاقۡرَءُوۡا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۙ وَاَقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَقۡرِضُوا اللّٰهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنًاؕ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوۡا لِاَنۡفُسِكُمۡ مِّنۡ خَيۡرٍ تَجِدُوۡهُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ هُوَ خَيۡرًا وَّاَعۡظَمَ اَجۡرًاؕ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوا اللّٰهَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌࣖ‏

Your Lord knows that you stand (in prayer) for nearly two thirds of the night, and (at times) for half of it, and (at times) for one third of it, and (so do) a group of those who are with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you (O Muslims,) cannot do it in regular way; therefore He turned to you in mercy.Now, recite as much of the Qur’ān as is easy (for you). He knows that some of you may be sick, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and yet others fighting in Allah’s way. Therefore, recite as much of it as is easy. And establish Salāh, and pay Zakāh, and advance to Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you will send ahead for your own-selves, you will find it with Allah much better in condition, and much greater in reward. And seek forgiveness from Allah. Indeed Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
74: O you, enveloped in a mantle,
and pronounce the greatness of your Lord,
and do not do a favour (to anyone merely) to seek more (in return).
And for the sake of your Lord, observe patience.
For when the trumpet will be blown,
that day will be a difficult day,
Leave me alone (to deal) with the one whom I created lonely,
and extended (power and honour) to him pretty well.
Still, he aspires that I should give him more.
Never! He is inimical towards Our verses.
I will force him to climb the mountain Sa‘ūd.
Death onto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!
Again, death unto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!
Then he looked (to those around him,)
then turned his back, and waxed proud,
فَقَالَ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ يُّؤۡثَرُۙ‏
then said, “This is nothing but traditional magic;
this is nothing but saying of a mortal.”
I will put him into Saqar (Hell).
And what can let you know what Saqar is?
It neither spares (anything inside it from burning) nor leaves (any disbeliever outside).

وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا٘ اَصۡحٰبَ النَّارِ اِلَّا مَلٰٓئِكَةًࣕ وَّمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ اِلَّا فِتۡنَةً لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاۙ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِيۡمَانًا وَّلَا يَرۡتَابَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ وَلِيَقُوۡلَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌ وَّالۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ مَاذَا٘ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ بِهٰذَا مَثَلًاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُوۡدَ رَبِّكَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ وَمَا هِيَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٰي لِلۡبَشَرِࣖ‏

And We did not make wardens of the Fire but (from) angels, and did not fix their number but as a test for those who disbelieve, so that those who are given the Book may come to believe, and those who believe may improve in belief, and so that those who are given the Book and those who believe may not doubt (its correctness), and so that those having malady in their hearts and the disbelievers say, “What has Allah meant by this strange statement?” Thus Allah lets go astray whomever He wills, and leads to the right path whomever He wills. And no one knows the hosts of your Lord but He. And this is nothing else but a reminder for mankind.
Truly, I swear by the moon,
and by the night when it goes back,
and by the morning when it becomes bright,
it (Saqar : Hell) is one of the greatest things
as a warning to the mankind,
لِمَنۡ شَآءَ مِنۡكُمۡ اَنۡ يَّتَقَدَّمَ اَوۡ يَتَاَخَّرَؕ‏
to the one from among you who wishes to come forward (towards good deeds) or to go back (from them).
Everyone will be detained (in the Hell) because of what he did,
except the People of the Right, (i.e. those who will be given their Book of Deeds in their right hands)
who will be in gardens, asking
They will say, “We were not among those who offered Salāh , (obligatory prayer)
and we did not give food to the needy,
and we indulged (in mocking at the truth) along with those who indulged,
and we used to deny the Day of Requital,
until when we were overtaken by that which is certain.”
Then intercession of intercessors will not benefit them.
So what has happened to them that they are turning away from the Reminder,
as if they were wild donkeys,
بَلۡ يُرِيۡدُ كُلُّ امۡرِئٍ مِّنۡهُمۡ اَنۡ يُّؤۡتٰي صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةًۙ‏
Rather, every one of them wishes that he should be given unrolled (divine) scriptures.
Never! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
Never! Indeed, this is a Reminder.
So, whoever so wishes may take advice from it.
وَمَا يَذۡكُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ هُوَ اَهۡلُ التَّقۡوٰي وَاَهۡلُ الۡمَغۡفِرَةِࣖ‏
And they will not take advice unless Allah so wills. He is worthy to be feared, and worthy to forgive.
75: لَا٘ اُقۡسِمُ بِيَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِۙ‏
I swear by the Day of Resurrection,
وَلَا٘ اُقۡسِمُ بِالنَّفۡسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ
and I swear by the self-reproaching conscience, (that Resurrection is a reality.)
اَيَحۡسَبُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَلَّنۡ نَّجۡمَعَ عِظَامَهٗؕ‏
Does man think that We will never reassemble his bones?
بَلٰي قٰدِرِيۡنَ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهٗ
Why (can We) not (do so), while We are able to reset (even) his fingertips perfectly?
بَلۡ يُرِيۡدُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ لِيَفۡجُرَ اَمَامَهٗۚ‏
But man wishes to go on violating Allah’s injunctions (even in future) ahead of him.
يَسۡـَٔلُ اَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ‏
He asks, “When will be this Day of Resurrection?”
فَاِذَا بَرِقَ الۡبَصَرُۙ‏
So, when the eyes will be dazzled,
وَخَسَفَ الۡقَمَرُۙ‏
and the moon will lose its light,
وَجُمِعَ الشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُۙ‏
and the sun and the moon will be joined together,
يَقُوۡلُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ اَيۡنَ الۡمَفَرُّۚ‏
on that day man will say, “Where to escape?”
كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَؕ‏
Never! There will be no refuge at all.
اِلٰي رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذِ اِۨلۡمُسۡتَقَرُّؕ‏
On that day, towards your Lord will be the destination (of everyone.)
يُنَبَّؤُا الۡاِنۡسَانُ يَوۡمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَاَخَّرَؕ‏
Man will be informed of what he sent ahead and what he left behind.
بَلِ الۡاِنۡسَانُ عَلٰي نَفۡسِهٖ بَصِيۡرَةٌۙ‏
Rather, man will be a witness against himself,
وَّلَوۡ اَلۡقٰي مَعَاذِيۡرَهٗؕ‏
even though he may offer his excuses.
لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهٖ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهٖؕ‏
(O Prophet,) do not move your tongue (during revelation) for (reciting) it (the Qur’ān) to receive it in hurry.
اِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا جَمۡعَهٗ وَقُرۡاٰنَهٗۚۖ‏
It is surely undertaken by Us to store it (in your heart), and to let it be recited (by you after revelation is completed).
فَاِذَا قَرَاۡنٰهُ فَاتَّبِعۡ قُرۡاٰنَهٗۚ‏
Therefore, when it is recited by Us (through the angel), follow its recitation (by concentration of your heart).
ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا بَيَانَهٗؕ‏
Then, it is undertaken by Us to explain it.
كَلَّا بَلۡ تُحِبُّوۡنَ الۡعَاجِلَةَۙ‏
Never, (your denial of Resurrection is never based on any sound reason!) Instead, you love that which is immediate,
وَتَذَرُوۡنَ الۡاٰخِرَةَؕ‏
and neglect the Hereafter.
وُجُوۡهٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌۙ‏
Many faces, that day, will be glowing,
اِلٰي رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۚ‏
looking towards their Lord,
وَوُجُوۡهٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۙ‏
and many faces, that day, will be gloomy,
تَظُنُّ اَنۡ يُّفۡعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌؕ‏
realizing that a back-breaking calamity is going to be afflicted on them.
كَلَّا٘ اِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَۙ‏
Never, (you will never remain in this world forever!) When the soul (of a patient) reaches the clavicles,
وَقِيۡلَ مَنۡࣝ رَاقٍۙ‏
and it is said, “Who is an enchanter (that can save him?)”
وَّظَنَّ اَنَّهُ الۡفِرَاقُۙ‏
and he realizes that it is (the time of) departure (from the world,)
وَالۡتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِۙ‏
and one shank is intertwined with the other shank,
اِلٰي رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذِ اِۨلۡمَسَاقُؕࣖ‏
then on that day, it is to your Lord that one has to be driven.
فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلّٰيۙ‏
So (the denier of the Hereafter) neither believed, nor prayed,
وَلٰكِنۡ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّٰيۙ‏
but rejected the truth and turned away (from it),
ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهٖ يَتَمَطّٰيؕ‏
then he went to his home, puffed up with pride.
اَوۡلٰي لَكَ فَاَوۡلٰيۙ‏
(It will be said to such a man,) Woe to you, then woe to you!
ثُمَّ اَوۡلٰي لَكَ فَاَوۡلٰيؕ‏
Again, woe to you, then woe to you!
اَيَحۡسَبُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنۡ يُّتۡرَكَ سُدًيؕ‏
Does man presume that he will be left unchecked?
اَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةً مِّنۡ مَّنِيٍّ يُّمۡنٰيۙ‏
Was he not an ejaculated drop of semen?
ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوّٰيۙ‏
Then he became a clot of blood, then He created (him) and made (him) perfect,
فَجَعَلَ مِنۡهُ الزَّوۡجَيۡنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالۡاُنۡثٰيؕ‏
and made from him two kinds, male and female.
اَلَيۡسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ يُّحۡيِۦَ الۡمَوۡتٰيࣖ‏
Has He no power to give life to the dead?
76: هَلۡ اَتٰي عَلَي الۡاِنۡسَانِ حِيۡنٌ مِّنَ الدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُنۡ شَيۡـًٔا مَّذۡكُوۡرًا
There has come upon man a period of time in which he was nothing worth mentioning.
اِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ اَمۡشَاجٍࣗۖ نَّبۡتَلِيۡهِ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُ سَمِيۡعًاۭ بَصِيۡرًاۚ‏
We have created man from a mixed sperm-drop to put him to a test; then We made him able to hear, able to see.
اِنَّا هَدَيۡنٰهُ السَّبِيۡلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَّاِمَّا كَفُوۡرًا
We have shown him the way to be either grateful or ungrateful.
اِنَّا٘ اَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ سَلٰسِلَا۠ وَاَغۡلٰلًا وَّسَعِيۡرًا
We have prepared, for the disbelievers, shackles and iron-collars and a blazing Fire.
اِنَّ الۡاَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُوۡنَ مِنۡ كَاۡسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوۡرًاۚ‏
Indeed, the righteous will have a drink from a goblet, blended with (a drink from) Camphor
عَيۡنًا يَّشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللّٰهِ يُفَجِّرُوۡنَهَا تَفۡجِيۡرًا
that will be a spring from which Allah’s servants will drink, making it flow (wherever they wish) profusely.
يُوۡفُوۡنَ بِالنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُوۡنَ يَوۡمًا كَانَ شَرُّهٗ مُسۡتَطِيۡرًا
They (are the ones who) fulfill their vows, and fear a day whose evil (events) will spread far and wide,
وَيُطۡعِمُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰي حُبِّهٖ مِسۡكِيۡنًا وَّيَتِيۡمًا وَّاَسِيۡرًا
and they give food, out of their love for Him (Allah), to the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,
اِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ اللّٰهِ لَا نُرِيۡدُ مِنۡكُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّلَا شُكُوۡرًا
(saying to them,) “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we have no intention of (receiving) either a return from you or thanks.
اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنۡ رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوۡسًا قَمۡطَرِيۡرًا
In fact, we are fearful of a day, from the side of our Lord, that will be frowning, extremely malignant.”
فَوَقٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقّٰىهُمۡ نَضۡرَةً وَّسُرُوۡرًاۚ‏
So Allah will save them from the evil of that day, and will grant them bloom and delight,
وَجَزٰىهُمۡ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا جَنَّةً وَّحَرِيۡرًاۙ‏
and will give them, in return for their patience, Paradise and (garments of) silk,
مُّتَّكِـِٕيۡنَ فِيۡهَا عَلَي الۡاَرَآئِكِۚ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيۡهَا شَمۡسًا وَّلَا زَمۡهَرِيۡرًاۚ‏
wherein they will be reclining on couches, feeling neither heat of the sun nor intense cold.
وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوۡفُهَا تَذۡلِيۡلًا
And shades of gardens will be hanging low on them, and their fruits will be placed totally under their command.
وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِاٰنِيَةٍ مِّنۡ فِضَّةٍ وَّاَكۡوَابٍ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيۡرَا۠ۙ‏
Circulated among them will be vessels of silver, and cups that will be (as transparent as) crystals,
قَوَارِيۡرَا۠ مِنۡ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوۡهَا تَقۡدِيۡرًا
-crystals (as shining as if made) of silver, measured by those (who filled them) with due measure.
وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيۡهَا كَاۡسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنۡجَبِيۡلًاۚ‏
And they will be served with goblet of a drink blended with ginger,
عَيۡنًا فِيۡهَا تُسَمّٰي سَلۡسَبِيۡلًا
(acquired from) a spring therein called Salsabīl.
وَيَطُوۡفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوۡنَۚ اِذَا رَاَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤًا مَّنۡثُوۡرًا
And circling around them will be serving boys, blessed with eternal youth; when you would see them, you would take them as scattered pearls.
وَاِذَا رَاَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَاَيۡتَ نَعِيۡمًا وَّمُلۡكًا كَبِيۡرًا
When you will look around there, you will see the Bliss and a magnificent realm.
عٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُنۡدُسٍ خُضۡرٌ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٌؗ وَّحُلُّوۡ٘ا اَسَاوِرَ مِنۡ فِضَّةٍۚ وَسَقٰىهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابًا طَهُوۡرًا

Upon them will be garments of green sundus (a kind of fine silk), and of istabraq (a kind of thick silk), and they will be adorned by bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure beverage to drink:
اِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّكَانَ سَعۡيُكُمۡ مَّشۡكُوۡرًاࣖ‏
“This is a reward for you, and your effort has been appreciated.”
اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ تَنۡزِيۡلًاۚ‏
Indeed we have revealed to you the Qur’ān through a gradual process.
فَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اٰثِمًا اَوۡ كَفُوۡرًاۚ‏
So, be steadfast patiently in (obeying) your Lord’s command, and do not obey any one of them who is sinner or ungrateful.
وَاذۡكُرِ اسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةً وَّاَصِيۡلًاۖۚ‏
And pronounce the name of Allah morning and evening.
وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَاسۡجُدۡ لَهٗ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلًا طَوِيۡلًا
And in some parts of night prostrate yourself before Him, and pronounce His purity for long times at night.
اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّوۡنَ الۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُوۡنَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمًا ثَقِيۡلًا
In fact these people love that which is immediate, and neglect a Heavy Day ahead of them.
نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَا٘ اَسۡرَهُمۡۚ وَاِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَا٘ اَمۡثَالَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيۡلًا
We have created them and have made their joints strong. And whenever We will, We would replace them with others like them, a total replacement.
اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذۡكِرَةٌۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيۡلًا
Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.
وَمَا تَشَآءُوۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيۡمًا حَكِيۡمًاࣗۙۖ‏
And you will not so wish unless Allah so wills. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
يُّدۡخِلُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ وَالظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًاࣖ‏
He admits whomsoever He wills to His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
77: وَالۡمُرۡسَلٰتِ عُرۡفًاۙ‏
(I swear) by those (winds) that are sent one after the other,
فَالۡعٰصِفٰتِ عَصۡفًاۙ‏
and by those that blow violently,
وَّالنّٰشِرٰتِ نَشۡرًاۙ‏
and by those that spread (clouds) all over,
فَالۡفٰرِقٰتِ فَرۡقًاۙ‏
and by those (angels) who differentiate (between right and wrong) distinctly,
فَالۡمُلۡقِيٰتِ ذِكۡرًاۙ‏
then bring down the advice,
عُذۡرًا اَوۡ نُذۡرًاۙ‏
leaving no excuse (for the disbelievers) or giving warnings,
اِنَّمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لَوَاقِعٌؕ‏
that which you are promised is sure to happen.
فَاِذَا النُّجُوۡمُ طُمِسَتۡۙ‏
So, when the stars will be extinguished,
وَاِذَا السَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتۡۙ‏
and when the sky will be split,
وَاِذَا الۡجِبَالُ نُسِفَتۡۙ‏
and when the mountains will be blown away as dust,
وَاِذَا الرُّسُلُ اُقِّتَتۡؕ‏
and when the messengers will be assembled at the appointed time, (then all matters will be decided.)
لِاَيِّ يَوۡمٍ اُجِّلَتۡؕ‏
(Do you know) for which day has all this been delayed?
لِيَوۡمِ الۡفَصۡلِۚ‏
For the Day of Decision!
وَمَا٘ اَدۡرٰىكَ مَا يَوۡمُ الۡفَصۡلِؕ‏
And what may let you know what the Day of Decision is?
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
اَلَمۡ نُهۡلِكِ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَؕ‏
Did We not destroy the earlier people?
ثُمَّ نُتۡبِعُهُمُ الۡاٰخِرِيۡنَ
Then We will cause the later ones to follow them.
كَذٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِالۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
Thus We deal with the guilty people.
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
اَلَمۡ نَخۡلُقۡكُّمۡ مِّنۡ مَّآءٍ مَّهِيۡنٍۙ‏
Did We not create you from a worthless fluid?
فَجَعَلۡنٰهُ فِيۡ قَرَارٍ مَّكِيۡنٍۙ‏
Then We put it in a firm place of rest
اِلٰي قَدَرٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍۙ‏
for a known period.
فَقَدَرۡنَاࣗۖ فَنِعۡمَ الۡقٰدِرُوۡنَ
Thus We did (all this with perfect) measure; so We are the best to measure.
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
اَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ الۡاَرۡضَ كِفَاتًاۙ‏
Did We not make the earth a container that collects
اَحۡيَآءً وَّاَمۡوَاتًاۙ‏
the living and the dead?
وَّجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا رَوَاسِيَ شٰمِخٰتٍ وَّاَسۡقَيۡنٰكُمۡ مَّآءً فُرَاتًاؕ‏
And We placed towering mountains therein, and provided you with sweet water to drink.
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
اِنۡطَلِقُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي مَا كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَۚ‏
(It will be said to them on that day,) “Push on to what you used to deny.
اِنۡطَلِقُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي ظِلٍّ ذِيۡ ثَلٰثِ شُعَبٍۙ‏
Push on to a canopy (of Hell’s smoke) having three branches,
لَّا ظَلِيۡلٍ وَّلَا يُغۡنِيۡ مِنَ اللَّهَبِؕ‏
that neither has a comfortable shade, nor is it of any use against the scorching heat.
اِنَّهَا تَرۡمِيۡ بِشَرَرٍ كَالۡقَصۡرِۚ‏
It emits sparks (as huge) as castles,
كَاَنَّهٗ جِمٰلَتٌ صُفۡرٌؕ‏
as if they were yellowish camels.”
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
هٰذَا يَوۡمُ لَا يَنۡطِقُوۡنَۙ‏
This is the day when they will not speak,
وَلَا يُؤۡذَنُ لَهُمۡ فَيَعۡتَذِرُوۡنَ
nor will they be allowed to offer excuses.
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
هٰذَا يَوۡمُ الۡفَصۡلِۚ جَمَعۡنٰكُمۡ وَالۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
(It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Decision. We have assembled you and the earlier ones together.
فَاِنۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡدٌ فَكِيۡدُوۡنِ
Now, if you have a trick, use the trick against Me.”
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَࣖ‏
Woe that Day to the deniers!
اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ ظِلٰلٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۙ‏
Of course, the God-fearing will be amid shades and streams,
وَّفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَؕ‏
and fruits of their desire.
كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَنِيۡٓـًٔاۭ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
It will be said to them, “Eat and drink with pleasure because of what you used to do.”
اِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
This is how We reward those who do good deeds.
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
كُلُوۡا وَتَمَتَّعُوۡا قَلِيۡلًا اِنَّكُمۡ مُّجۡرِمُوۡنَ
“(O disbelievers,) eat and drink for a while! You are guilty ones.”
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ ارۡكَعُوۡا لَا يَرۡكَعُوۡنَ
And when it is said to them, “Bow down (i.e. submit to Allah’s commands)”, they do not bow down.
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
Woe that Day to the deniers!
فَبِاَيِّ حَدِيۡثٍۭ بَعۡدَهٗ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
Now, in which discourse, after this, will they believe?
78: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُوۡنَۚ‏
About what are they asking each other?
عَنِ النَّبَاِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۙ‏
About the Great Event
الَّذِيۡ هُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُخۡتَلِفُوۡنَؕ‏
in which they dispute!
كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
Indeed they will soon know.
ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
Again, indeed they will soon know.
اَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ الۡاَرۡضَ مِهٰدًاۙ‏
Did We not make the earth a floor,
وَّالۡجِبَالَ اَوۡتَادًاۙ‏
and the mountains bulwarks?
وَّخَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ اَزۡوَاجًاۙ‏
And We have created you in pairs,
وَّجَعَلۡنَا نَوۡمَكُمۡ سُبَاتًاۙ‏
and made your sleep a source of rest,
وَّجَعَلۡنَا الَّيۡلَ لِبَاسًاۙ‏
and made the night a covering,
وَّجَعَلۡنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًاۚ‏
and made the day a source of livelihood.
وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعًا شِدَادًاۙ‏
And We have built seven strong (skies),
وَّجَعَلۡنَا سِرَاجًا وَّهَّاجًاۙ‏
and created a luminous lamp (the sun).
وَّاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ الۡمُعۡصِرٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًاۙ‏
And We have sent down abundant water from the rain-laden clouds,
لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهٖ حَبًّا وَّنَبَاتًاۙ‏
so that We bring out therewith grain and vegetation,
وَّجَنّٰتٍ اَلۡفَافًاؕ‏
and thick gardens.
اِنَّ يَوۡمَ الۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيۡقَاتًاۙ‏
Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,
يَّوۡمَ يُنۡفَخُ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَتَاۡتُوۡنَ اَفۡوَاجًاۙ‏
a day when the trumpet will be blown, so you will come in multitudes,
وَّفُتِحَتِ السَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ اَبۡوَابًاۙ‏
and the sky will be opened, so it will become as gates,
وَّسُيِّرَتِ الۡجِبَالُ فَكَانَتۡ سَرَابًاؕ‏
and the mountains will be set in motion, so they will be as mirage.
اِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتۡ مِرۡصَادًاۙ‏
Surely Jahannam (the Hell) lurks in ambush.
لِّلطّٰغِيۡنَ مَاٰبًاۙ‏
(It is) abode for the rebellious people
لّٰبِثِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَحۡقَابًاۚ‏
who will be abiding in it for ages.
لَا يَذُوۡقُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بَرۡدًا وَّلَا شَرَابًاۙ‏
They will taste nothing cool in it, nor a drink,
اِلَّا حَمِيۡمًا وَّغَسَّاقًاۙ‏
except boiling water and pus,
جَزَآءً وِّفَاقًاؕ‏
this being a punishment, fully commensurate (with their deeds).
اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ حِسَابًاۙ‏
They did not expect (to face) accounting (of their deeds),
وَّكَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا كِذَّابًاؕ‏
and they rejected Our signs totally.
وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ اَحۡصَيۡنٰهُ كِتٰبًاۙ‏
And everything (from their deeds) is thoroughly recorded by Us in writing.
فَذُوۡقُوۡا فَلَنۡ نَّزِيۡدَكُمۡ اِلَّا عَذَابًاࣖ‏
“So now taste! We will add nothing to you but torment.”
اِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ مَفَازًاۙ‏
Of course, the God-fearing will have great achievement,
حَدَآئِقَ وَاَعۡنَابًاۙ‏
-gardens and grapes,
وَّكَوَاعِبَ اَتۡرَابًاۙ‏
and buxom maidens of matching age,
وَّكَاۡسًا دِهَاقًاؕ‏
and goblets filled up to the brim.
لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا لَغۡوًا وَّلَا كِذّٰبًاۚۖ‏
They will not hear any vain talk therein, nor lies,
جَزَآءً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًاۙ‏
this being a reward from their Lord, a well calculated grant,
رَّبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا الرَّحۡمٰنِ لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابًاۚ‏
(from) the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the All-Merciful. No one will have power to address Him,
يَوۡمَ يَقُوۡمُ الرُّوۡحُ وَالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّاؕࣗۙ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُوۡنَ اِلَّا مَنۡ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
on the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows. They will not speak, except the one who is permitted by the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) and speaks aright.
ذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمُ الۡحَقُّۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ مَاٰبًا
That is the Day that is sure to come. So whoever so wishes may take refuge with his Lord.
اِنَّا٘ اَنۡذَرۡنٰكُمۡ عَذَابًا قَرِيۡبًا ࣢ۚۖ يَّوۡمَ يَنۡظُرُ الۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدٰهُ وَيَقُوۡلُ الۡكَافِرُ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ كُنۡتُ تُرٰبًاࣖ‏
We have warned you of an approaching torment (that will be inflicted) on a day when one will see what his hands have sent ahead, and the disbeliever will say, “O would that I had turned into dust.”
79: وَالنّٰزِعٰتِ غَرۡقًاۙ‏
I swear by those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the infidels) with extreme force,
وَّالنّٰشِطٰتِ نَشۡطًاۙ‏
and by those (angels) who untie the knot (of the souls of the believers) smoothly,
وَّالسّٰبِحٰتِ سَبۡحًاۙ‏
and by those who float (in the atmosphere) swiftly,
فَالسّٰبِقٰتِ سَبۡقًاۙ‏
then proceed forward quickly,
فَالۡمُدَبِّرٰتِ اَمۡرًاۘ‏
then manage (to do) everything (they are ordered to do,)
يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُۙ‏
(you will be resurrected) on the Day when the shocking event (i.e. the first blowing of the trumpet) will shock (everything),
تَتۡبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُؕ‏
followed by the next one (i.e. the second blowing of the trumpet.)
قُلُوۡبٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ وَّاجِفَةٌۙ‏
On that day, hearts (of people) will be throbbing,
اَبۡصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌۘ‏
with their eyes downcast.
يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ ءَاِنَّا لَمَرۡدُوۡدُوۡنَ فِي الۡحَافِرَةِؕ‏
They (the infidels) say, “Are we going to be brought back to our former state (of Life)?
ءَاِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا نَّخِرَةًؕ‏
Is it when we are turned into decayed bones?”
قَالُوۡا تِلۡكَ اِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۘ‏
They say, “If so, that will be a harmful homecoming.”
فَاِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌۙ‏
In fact, it will be only a single harsh voice,
فَاِذَا هُمۡ بِالسَّاهِرَةِؕ‏
and in no time they will be (brought) into the plain (of Hashr).
هَلۡ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيۡثُ مُوۡسٰيۘ‏
Has there come to you the narrative about Mūsā?
اِذۡ نَادٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ بِالۡوَادِ الۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًيۚ‏
(Recall) when his Lord called to him in the blessed valley of Tuwā:
اِذۡهَبۡ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰيؗۖ‏
“Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh). Indeed, he has crossed all bounds.
فَقُلۡ هَلۡ لَّكَ اِلٰ٘ي اَنۡ تَزَكّٰيۙ‏
And say (to him,) ‘Would you like to purify yourself,
وَاَهۡدِيَكَ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشٰيۚ‏
and that I should guide you to your Lord, so that you fear (Him)?’”
فَاَرٰىهُ الۡاٰيَةَ الۡكُبۡرٰيؗۖ‏
So, he (Mūsā) showed him the biggest sign.
فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصٰيؗۖ‏
But he rejected and disobeyed,
ثُمَّ اَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعٰيؗۖ‏
then he turned back, and tried hard (to refute the Messenger),
فَحَشَرَࣞ فَنَادٰيؗۖ‏
then he gathered (his people) and shouted
فَقَالَ اَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الۡاَعۡلٰيؗۖ‏
and said, “I am your supreme lord.”
فَاَخَذَهُ اللّٰهُ نَكَالَ الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَالۡاُوۡلٰيؕ‏
So, Allah seized him for an exemplary punishment in the Hereafter and the present world.
اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةً لِّمَنۡ يَّخۡشٰيؕࣖ‏
Indeed, there is a lesson for him who fears (Allah).
ءَاَنۡتُمۡ اَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا اَمِ السَّمَآءُؕ بَنٰىهَاࣞ‏
Is your creation more difficult or that of the sky? He has built it,
رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوّٰىهَاۙ‏
He has raised its height, then made it proper,
وَاَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَاَخۡرَجَ ضُحٰىهَاࣕ‏
and darkened its night, and brought forth its daylight,
وَالۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذٰلِكَ دَحٰىهَاؕ‏
and, after that, He spread out the earth.
اَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعٰىهَاࣕ‏
From it, He brought out its water and its meadows,
وَالۡجِبَالَ اَرۡسٰىهَاۙ‏
and firmly fixed the mountains,
مَتَاعًا لَّكُمۡ وَ لِاَنۡعَامِكُمۡؕ‏
(all this) as a benefit to you and your cattle.
فَاِذَا جَآءَتِ الطَّآمَّةُ الۡكُبۡرٰيؗۖ‏
So when the Greatest Havoc will take place
يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مَا سَعٰيۙ‏
on the day when man will recall what he did,
وَبُرِّزَتِ الۡجَحِيۡمُ لِمَنۡ يَّرٰي
and the Hell will be exposed for all who see,
فَاَمَّا مَنۡ طَغٰيۙ‏
then for the one who had rebelled,
وَاٰثَرَ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَاۙ‏
and preferred the worldly life (to the Hereafter),
فَاِنَّ الۡجَحِيۡمَ هِيَ الۡمَاۡوٰيؕ‏
the Hell will be the abode,
وَاَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهٖ وَنَهَي النَّفۡسَ عَنِ الۡهَوٰيۙ‏
whereas for the one who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained his self from the (evil) desire,
فَاِنَّ الۡجَنَّةَ هِيَ الۡمَاۡوٰيؕ‏
the Paradise will be the abode.
يَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ اَيَّانَ مُرۡسٰىهَاؕ‏
They ask you (O Prophet,) about the Hour (the Day of Judgment) as to when it will take place.
فِيۡمَ اَنۡتَ مِنۡ ذِكۡرٰىهَاؕ‏
In which capacity are you to tell this?
اِلٰي رَبِّكَ مُنۡتَهٰىهَاؕ‏
With your Lord is the final word about it.
اِنَّمَا٘ اَنۡتَ مُنۡذِرُ مَنۡ يَّخۡشٰىهَاؕ‏
You are only a warner for anyone who fears it.
كَاَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا عَشِيَّةً اَوۡ ضُحٰىهَاࣖ‏
The day they will see it, it will seem to them as if they did not live (in the world) but only for one afternoon or for the morning thereof.
80: He (the Prophet) frowned and turned his face,
because the blind man came to him!
What could tell you (O prophet about the prospects of the blind man?) May be, (if you had attended him properly,) he would have attained purity,
or have received the advice, and the advice would have benefited him.
As for the one who does not care (about faith),
you are anxious to pursue him,
while there is no blame on you, if he does not attain purity.
As regards the one who has come to you rushing eagerly,
to him you pay no heed!
Never! (you should never act in this way,) Indeed this (Qur’ān) is an advice.
So, whoever so wills may pay heed to it.
It is (recorded) in those scripts (of the Preserved Tablet) that are honoured,
in the hands of those scribes
Damned is the man! How ungrateful he is!
From which stuff did He (Allah) create him?
from a drop of semen! He created him, and designed him in due proportion,
then He made the way easy for him,
Later, he made him die, and put him into grave,
Thereafter, when He will intend, He will raise him up.
No! He has not yet fulfilled what He (Allah) had commanded him.
So, the man should consider his food,
then how nicely We split the earth,
then We grew in it grain,
and gardens, full of thick trees,
as a benefit for you and your cattle.
So when the Deafening Noise will occur,
the Day when one will flee from his brother,
and from his mother and father,
and from his wife and sons,
لِكُلِّ امۡرِئٍ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ شَاۡنٌ يُّغۡنِيۡهِؕ‏
every one of them will be too engaged in his own affairs to care for others.
Many faces, on that day, will be bright,
and many faces, on that day, will be stained with dust,
Those are the disbelievers, the nefarious.
81: اِذَا الشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡࣕۙ‏
When the sun will be folded up,
وَاِذَا النُّجُوۡمُ انۡكَدَرَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the stars will swoop down,
وَاِذَا الۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the mountains will be set in motion,
وَاِذَا الۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the ten-months pregnant she-camels will be abandoned,
وَاِذَا الۡوُحُوۡشُ حُشِرَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the wild beasts will be gathered together,
وَاِذَا الۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the seas will be flared up,
وَاِذَا النُّفُوۡسُ زُوِّجَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the people will be arranged in categories,
وَاِذَا الۡمَوۡءٗدَةُ سُئِلَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the girl-child that was buried alive will be asked,
بِاَيِّ ذَنۭۡ بٍ قُتِلَتۡۚ‏
for what sin she was killed,
وَاِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the scrolls (of deeds) will be unrolled,
وَاِذَا السَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the sky will be stripped off,
وَاِذَا الۡجَحِيۡمُ سُعِّرَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the Hell will be set ablaze,
وَاِذَا الۡجَنَّةُ اُزۡلِفَتۡࣕۙ‏
and when the Paradise will be brought close,
عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٌ مَّا٘ اَحۡضَرَتۡؕ‏
then everyone will know what he (or she) has put forward.
فَلَا٘ اُقۡسِمُ بِالۡخُنَّسِۙ‏
So, I swear by those (stars) that recede,
الۡجَوَارِ الۡكُنَّسِۙ‏
that proceed, that withdraw from the scene,
وَالَّيۡلِ اِذَا عَسۡعَسَۙ‏
and by the night when it departs,
وَالصُّبۡحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَۙ‏
and the morning when it starts breathing,
اِنَّهٗ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُوۡلٍ كَرِيۡمٍۙ‏
it (the Qur’ān) is surely the word of a noble messenger (Jibra’īl X),
ذِيۡ قُوَّةٍ عِنۡدَ ذِي الۡعَرۡشِ مَكِيۡنٍۙ‏
the one possessing power and a high status with the Lord of the Throne,
مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ اَمِيۡنٍؕ‏
the one obeyed there, trusted.
وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمۡ بِمَجۡنُوۡنٍۚ‏
Your companion (Muhammad ) is not a madman,
وَلَقَدۡ رَاٰهُ بِالۡاُفُقِ الۡمُبِيۡنِۚ‏
and he did see him (Jibra’īl X) on the clear horizon.
وَمَا هُوَ عَلَي الۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِيۡنٍۚ‏
And he (the Prophet) is not stingy about (the news of) the unseen.
وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطٰنٍ رَّجِيۡمٍۙ‏
Nor is it the word of an outcast satan (devil).
فَاَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُوۡنَؕ‏
Then where are you going?
اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
It is nothing else but a message of advice for all the worlds,
لِمَنۡ شَآءَ مِنۡكُمۡ اَنۡ يَّسۡتَقِيۡمَؕ‏
for the benefit of any one from among you who intends to go straight.
وَمَا تَشَآءُوۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَࣖ‏
And you cannot intend (to do anything) unless it is so willed by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
82: اِذَا السَّمَآءُ انۡفَطَرَتۡۙ‏
When the sky will be cleft asunder,
وَاِذَا الۡكَوَاكِبُ انۡتَثَرَتۡۙ‏
and when the stars will disperse,
وَاِذَا الۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡۙ‏
and when the seas will be burst forth,
وَاِذَا الۡقُبُوۡرُ بُعۡثِرَتۡۙ‏
and when the graves will be overturned,
عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَاَخَّرَتۡؕ‏
then one will know what he sent ahead and what he left behind.
يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡاِنۡسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الۡكَرِيۡمِۙ‏
O man! What has deceived you about your Gracious Lord,
الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكَ فَسَوّٰىكَ فَعَدَلَكَۙ‏
who created you, then perfected you, then brought you in due proportion?
فِيۡ٘ اَيِّ صُوۡرَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَؕ‏
He composed you in whichever form He willed.
كَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ بِالدِّيۡنِۙ‏
Never! (i.e. one should never be heedless towards him.) But you deny the Requital,
وَاِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحٰفِظِيۡنَۙ‏
while (appointed) over you there are watchers,
كِرَامًا كٰتِبِيۡنَۙ‏
who are noble, writers (of the deeds),
يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَا تَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
who know whatever you do.
اِنَّ الۡاَبۡرَارَ لَفِيۡ نَعِيۡمٍۙ‏
Surely the righteous will be in bliss,
وَّاِنَّ الۡفُجَّارَ لَفِيۡ جَحِيۡمٍۙ‏
and the sinners in Hell,
يَّصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ الدِّيۡنِ
in which they will enter on the Day of Requital,
وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِيۡنَؕ‏
and they will not (be able to) keep away from it.
وَمَا٘ اَدۡرٰىكَ مَا يَوۡمُ الدِّيۡنِۙ‏
And what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?
ثُمَّ مَا٘ اَدۡرٰىكَ مَا يَوۡمُ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
Again, what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?
يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٌ لِّنَفۡسٍ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَالۡاَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلّٰهِࣖ‏
A Day when no one will have power to do any thing for another! And command, on that Day, will belong to Allah (alone).
83: وَيۡلٌ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِيۡنَۙ‏
Woe to the curtailers
الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا اكۡتَالُوۡا عَلَي النَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُوۡنَؗۖ‏
who, when they measure something to receive from people, take it in full,
وَاِذَا كَالُوۡهُمۡ اَوۡ وَّزَنُوۡهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُوۡنَؕ‏
and when they measure or weigh something to give it to them, give less than due.
اَلَا يَظُنُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَنَّهُمۡ مَّبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَۙ‏
Do they not think that they have to be raised up
لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍۙ‏
on a Great Day,
يَّوۡمَ يَقُوۡمُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
the Day when all the people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
كَلَّا٘ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الۡفُجَّارِ لَفِيۡ سِجِّيۡنٍؕ‏
Never! (i.e. they should never act in such a way.) Indeed the record of deeds of the sinners is in Sijjīn .
وَمَا٘ اَدۡرٰىكَ مَا سِجِّيۡنٌؕ‏
And what may let you know what Sijjīn is?
كِتٰبٌ مَّرۡقُوۡمٌؕ‏
A register, inscribed!
وَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَۙ‏
Woe that day to the deniers,
الَّذِيۡنَ يُكَذِّبُوۡنَ بِيَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
who deny the Day of Requital!
وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهٖ٘ اِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ اَثِيۡمٍۙ‏
And none denies it but every sinful transgressor.
اِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَؕ‏
When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) tales of the ancients.”
كَلَّا بَلۡࣝ رَانَ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
No! But that which they used to commit has covered their hearts with rust.
كَلَّا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ عَنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّمَحۡجُوۡبُوۡنَؕ‏
No! Indeed they will be screened off from their Lord on that Day.
ثُمَّ اِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُوا الۡجَحِيۡمِؕ‏
Then they will have to enter the Hell.
ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَؕ‏
Then it will be said, “This is what you used to deny.”
كَلَّا٘ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الۡاَبۡرَارِ لَفِيۡ عِلِّيِّيۡنَؕ‏
No! The record of deeds of the righteous is in ‘Illiyyūn .
وَمَا٘ اَدۡرٰىكَ مَا عِلِّيُّوۡنَؕ‏
And what may let you know what ‘Illiyyūn is ?
كِتٰبٌ مَّرۡقُوۡمٌۙ‏
A register inscribed,
يَّشۡهَدُهُ الۡمُقَرَّبُوۡنَؕ‏
attended by those (angels) who are blessed with nearness to Allah!
اِنَّ الۡاَبۡرَارَ لَفِيۡ نَعِيۡمٍۙ‏
Indeed the righteous will be in absolute bliss.
عَلَي الۡاَرَآئِكِ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَۙ‏
While (sitting) on thrones they will be watching (the scenes of Paradise).
تَعۡرِفُ فِيۡ وُجُوۡهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ النَّعِيۡمِۚ‏
You will recognize the glamour of bliss on their faces.
يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِنۡ رَّحِيۡقٍ مَّخۡتُوۡمٍۙ‏
They will be served with a pure sealed wine to drink,
خِتٰمُهٗ مِسۡكٌؕ وَفِيۡ ذٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ الۡمُتَنٰفِسُوۡنَؕ‏
the seal of which will be of musk.-It is this (bliss) in aspiring for which the competitors should race each other.
وَمِزَاجُهٗ مِنۡ تَسۡنِيۡمٍۙ‏
-and it will be blended with (a drink from) Tasnīm ,
عَيۡنًا يَّشۡرَبُ بِهَا الۡمُقَرَّبُوۡنَؕ‏
a spring from which will drink those who are blessed with nearness.
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اَجۡرَمُوۡا كَانُوۡا مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَؗۖ‏
Indeed those who were guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
وَاِذَا مَرُّوۡا بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُوۡنَؗۖ‏
and when they passed by them, they used to wink at one another,
وَاِذَا انۡقَلَبُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهِمُ انۡقَلَبُوۡا فَكِهِيۡنَؗۖ‏
and when they went back to their family, they went enjoying their mockery,
وَاِذَا رَاَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّوۡنَۙ‏
and when they saw them, they said, “Surely these are the ones who have gone astray”
وَمَا٘ اُرۡسِلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حٰفِظِيۡنَؕ‏
while they were not sent as watchmen over them.
فَالۡيَوۡمَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مِنَ الۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُوۡنَۙ‏
So, today those who believed will laugh at the disbelievers.
عَلَي الۡاَرَآئِكِۙ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَؕ‏
While (sitting) on thrones, they will be seeing
هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ الۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
whether the disbelievers have been paid back for what they used to do.
84: اِذَا السَّمَآءُ انۡشَقَّتۡۙ‏
When the sky will split apart,
وَاَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡۙ‏
and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,-
وَاِذَا الۡاَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡؕ‏
and when the earth will be stretched (to give room to more people),
وَاَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيۡهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡۙ‏
and it will throw up whatever it contains, and will become empty,
وَاَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡؕ‏
and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,- (then man will see the consequences of his deeds.)
يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡاِنۡسَانُ اِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ كَدۡحًا فَمُلٰقِيۡهِۚ‏
O man, you have to work hard constantly to reach your Lord, and then you have to meet Him.
فَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِيَمِيۡنِهٖۙ‏
So, as for him whose book (of deeds) will be given to him in his right hand,
فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَّسِيۡرًاۙ‏
he will be called to account in an easy manner,
وَّيَنۡقَلِبُ اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهٖ مَسۡرُوۡرًاؕ‏
and he will go back to his people joyfully.
وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهٖۙ‏
As for the one whose book (of deeds) will be given to him from his backside,
فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُوۡا ثُبُوۡرًاۙ‏
he will pray for death,
وَّيَصۡلٰي سَعِيۡرًاؕ‏
and will enter the blazing fire.
اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فِيۡ٘ اَهۡلِهٖ مَسۡرُوۡرًاؕ‏
He had been joyful among his people (in the world).
He thought he would never revert (to Allah).
بَلٰ٘يۚۛ اِنَّ رَبَّهٗ كَانَ بِهٖ بَصِيۡرًاؕ‏
No! Indeed his Lord was watchful over him.
فَلَا٘ اُقۡسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِۙ‏
So, I swear by the twilight (after sunset),
وَالَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَۙ‏
and by the night and what it envelops,
وَالۡقَمَرِ اِذَا اتَّسَقَۙ‏
and by the moon when it develops at the full,
لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنۡ طَبَقٍؕ‏
you shall certainly ascend from stage to stage.
فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
So, what is wrong with them that they do not believe,
وَاِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقُرۡاٰنُ لَا يَسۡجُدُوۡنَࣛؕ‏
and when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not offer sajdah (prostration)?
بَلِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يُكَذِّبُوۡنَؗۖ‏
Rather, those who disbelieve deny (the truth).
وَاللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوۡعُوۡنَؗۖ‏
And Allah is most aware of what they store.
فَبَشِّرۡهُمۡ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍۙ‏
So, give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment,
اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍࣖ‏
but those who believed and did righteous deeds will have a reward that will never be interrupted.
85: وَالسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الۡبُرُوۡجِۙ‏
I swear by the sky, the one having stellar formations,
وَالۡيَوۡمِ الۡمَوۡعُوۡدِۙ‏
and by the Promised Day,
وَشَاهِدٍ وَّمَشۡهُوۡدٍؕ‏
and by that which attends, and that which is attended,
قُتِلَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡاُخۡدُوۡدِۙ‏
cursed were the People of the Trench,
النَّارِ ذَاتِ الۡوَقُوۡدِۙ‏
the (people of the) fire that was rich with fuel,
اِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُوۡدٌۙ‏
when they were sitting by it,
وَّهُمۡ عَلٰي مَا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ بِالۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ شُهُوۡدٌؕ‏
and were watching what they were doing with the believers.
وَمَا نَقَمُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَمِيۡدِۙ‏
They punished them for nothing but that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Worthy of All Praise,
الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيۡدٌؕ‏
the One to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is witness over every thing.
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ فَتَنُوا الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوۡبُوۡا فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ الۡحَرِيۡقِؕ‏
Surely, those who persecuted the believing men and the believing women, then did not repent, -for them there is the torment of Jahannam (Hell), and for them there is the torment of burning.
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٌ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُؕ ذٰلِكَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡكَبِيۡرُؕ‏
As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them there are gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the big achievement.
اِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيۡدٌؕ‏
The seizure of your Lord is severe indeed!
اِنَّهٗ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيۡدُۚ‏
Surely He originates (creation) and repeats (it after death).
وَهُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الۡوَدُوۡدُۙ‏
And He is the Most-Forgiving, the Most-Loving,
ذُو الۡعَرۡشِ الۡمَجِيۡدُۙ‏
the Master of the Throne, the Glorious.
فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيۡدُؕ‏
He is ever doer of what He intends.
هَلۡ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيۡثُ الۡجُنُوۡدِۙ‏
Has there come to you the story of the forces,
فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُوۡدَؕ‏
of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamūd?
بَلِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فِيۡ تَكۡذِيۡبٍۙ‏
But those who disbelieve are (engaged) in denying (the truth).
وَّاللّٰهُ مِنۡ وَّرَآئِهِمۡ مُّحِيۡطٌۚ‏
Allah has encompassed them from all sides.
بَلۡ هُوَ قُرۡاٰنٌ مَّجِيۡدٌۙ‏
The reality is that it is the glorious Qur’ān,
فِيۡ لَوۡحٍ مَّحۡفُوۡظٍࣖ‏
(recorded) in the Preserved Tablet (LauH MaHfūZ).
86: I swear by the sky and by the Night-Comer,-
-and what may let you know what the Night-Comer is?
اِنۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٌؕ‏
-there is no human being, but there is a watcher over him.
So, let man consider of which stuff he is created.
He is created of spouting water
that comes out from between the loins and the chest-bones.
Surely He is Powerful to bring him back
on a day when all the secrets will be searched out,
فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ قُوَّةٍ وَّلَا نَاصِرٍؕ‏
and he will have neither strength (to defend), nor a supporter.
I swear by the sky that rains,
and the earth that cracks open (for plants),
and it is not a joke.
So leave the disbelievers alone at the moment; give them respite for a while.
87: سَبِّحِ اسۡمَ رَبِّكَ الۡاَعۡلَيۙ‏
Pronounce the purity of the name of your most exalted Lord,
الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ فَسَوّٰيࣕۙ‏
who created (everything), then made (it) well,
وَالَّذِيۡ قَدَّرَ فَهَدٰيࣕۙ‏
and who determined a measure (for everything), then guided (it),
وَالَّذِيۡ٘ اَخۡرَجَ الۡمَرۡعٰيࣕۙ‏
and who brought forth pasturage,
فَجَعَلَهٗ غُثَآءً اَحۡوٰيؕ‏
then turned it into a blackening stubble.
سَنُقۡرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنۡسٰ٘يۙ‏
We will make you recite, then you will not forget
اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ الۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفٰيؕ‏
except that which Allah wills. Indeed He knows what is manifest and what is hidden.
وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلۡيُسۡرٰيۚۖ‏
And We will facilitate for you (to reach) the easiest way.
فَذَكِّرۡ اِنۡ نَّفَعَتِ الذِّكۡرٰيؕ‏
So, extend advice (to people) if advice is useful.
سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَنۡ يَّخۡشٰيۙ‏
The one who fears (Allah) will observe the advice,
وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الۡاَشۡقَيۙ‏
and it will be avoided by the most wretched one
الَّذِيۡ يَصۡلَي النَّارَ الۡكُبۡرٰيۚ‏
who will enter the Biggest Fire,
ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوۡتُ فِيۡهَا وَلَا يَحۡيٰيؕ‏
then he will neither die therein, nor live (a desirable life).
قَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ مَنۡ تَزَكّٰيۙ‏
Success is surely achieved by him who purifies himself,
وَذَكَرَ اسۡمَ رَبِّهٖ فَصَلّٰيؕ‏
and pronounces the name of his Lord, then offers prayer.
بَلۡ تُؤۡثِرُوۡنَ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَاۙ‏
But you prefer the worldly life,
وَالۡاٰخِرَةُ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰيؕ‏
while the Hereafter is much better and much more durable.
اِنَّ هٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الۡاُوۡلٰيۙ‏
Indeed this is (written) in the earlier divine scripts,
صُحُفِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَمُوۡسٰيࣖ‏
the scripts of Ibrāhīm and Mūsā.
88: Has there come to you the description of the Overwhelming Event?
Many faces that day will be humbled,
They will enter into the scorching fire.
They will be made to drink water from a boiling spring.
لَيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِنۡ ضَرِيۡعٍۙ‏
There will be no food for them except from a thorny plant
لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِيۡ مِنۡ جُوۡعٍؕ‏
that will neither nourish, nor satisfy hunger.
Many faces that day will be full of glamour,
in which they will not hear any absurd talk.
In it there is a flowing spring.
In it there are elevated couches
اَفَلَا يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَي الۡاِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡࣟ‏
So, do they not look at the camels how they are created,
and at the sky, how it is raised high,
and at the mountains, how they are installed,
and at the earth, how it is spread out?
So, (O Prophet,) keep on preaching; you are only a preacher.
You are not a taskmaster set up over them,
but whoever turns away and disbelieves,
Allah will punish him with the greatest torment.
Surely towards Us they have to return,
then it is Our job to call them to account.
89: وَالۡفَجۡرِۙ‏
I swear by the dawn,
وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرٍۙ‏
and by Ten Nights,
وَّالشَّفۡعِ وَالۡوَتۡرِۙ‏
and by the even and the odd,
وَالَّيۡلِ اِذَا يَسۡرِۚ‏
and by the night when it moves away,
هَلۡ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِيۡ حِجۡرٍؕ‏
-Is there (not) in such an oath (enough assurance) for a man of sense?-
اَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍۙࣕ‏
Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with (the people) of ‘Ād
اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الۡعِمَادِۙࣕ‏
of Iram , the men of tall pillars,
الَّتِيۡ لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي الۡبِلَادِۙࣕ‏
the like of whom were never created in the lands,
وَثَمُوۡدَ الَّذِيۡنَ جَابُوا الصَّخۡرَ بِالۡوَادِۙࣕ‏
and (how He dealt) with (the people of) Thamūd who had carved out the rocks in the Valley (of Qurā),
وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي الۡاَوۡتَادِۙࣕ‏
and with Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of the stakes,
الَّذِيۡنَ طَغَوۡا فِي الۡبِلَادِۙࣕ‏
- those who had rebelled in the cities,
فَاَكۡثَرُوۡا فِيۡهَا الۡفَسَادَۙࣕ‏
and spread a lot of mischief therein.
فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍۙۚ‏
So, your Lord let loose on them the whip of torment.
اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالۡمِرۡصَادِؕ‏
Surely your Lord is ever on the watch.
فَاَمَّا الۡاِنۡسَانُ اِذَا مَا ابۡتَلٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ فَاَكۡرَمَهٗ وَنَعَّمَهٗ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَكۡرَمَنِؕ‏
As for man, when his Lord tests him, and thus gives him honour and bounties, he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”
وَاَمَّا٘ اِذَا مَا ابۡتَلٰىهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهٗ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَهَانَنِۚ‏
But when he tests him, and thus straitens his provision for him, he says, “My Lord has disgraced me.”
كَلَّا بَلۡ لَّا تُكۡرِمُوۡنَ الۡيَتِيۡمَۙ‏
No! But you do not honour the orphan,
وَلَا تَحٰٓضُّوۡنَ عَلٰي طَعَامِ الۡمِسۡكِيۡنِۙ‏
and do not encourage one another to feed the needy.
وَتَاۡكُلُوۡنَ التُّرَاثَ اَكۡلًا لَّمًّاۙ‏
And you devour the inheritance with a sweeping gulp,
وَّتُحِبُّوۡنَ الۡمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّاؕ‏
and love wealth, an excessive love.
كَلَّا٘ اِذَا دُكَّتِ الۡاَرۡضُ دَكًّا دَكًّاۙ‏
No! When the earth will be crushed thoroughly to be turned into bits,
وَّجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَالۡمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّاۚ‏
and your Lord will come, and the angels as well, lined up in rows,
وَجِايۡٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ࣢ۙ يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّتَذَكَّرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ وَاَنّٰي لَهُ الذِّكۡرٰيؕ‏
and Jahannam (Hell), on that day, will be brought forward, it will be the day when man will realize the truth, but from where will he take advantage of such realization?
يَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِيۡۚ‏
He will say, “O Would that I had sent ahead (some good deeds) for (this) my life!”
فَيَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهٗ٘ اَحَدٌۙ‏
So no one can punish like He will punish, that day,
وَّلَا يُوۡثِقُ وَثَاقَهٗ٘ اَحَدٌؕ‏
nor can anyone shackle like He will shackle.
يٰ٘اَيَّتُهَا النَّفۡسُ الۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُۙࣗ‏
(As for an obedient man, it will be said to him,) “O content soul,
ارۡجِعِيۡ٘ اِلٰي رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرۡضِيَّةًۚ‏
come back to your Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing.
فَادۡخُلِيۡ فِيۡ عِبٰدِيۡۙ‏
So, enter among My (special) servants,
وَادۡخُلِيۡ جَنَّتِيۡࣖ‏
and enter My Paradise.”
90: لَا٘ اُقۡسِمُ بِهٰذَا الۡبَلَدِۙ‏
I swear by this city,
وَاَنۡتَ حِلٌّۭ بِهٰذَا الۡبَلَدِۙ‏
-and (O Prophet,) you are going to be allowed (to fight) in this city-
وَوَالِدٍ وَّمَا وَلَدَۙ‏
and by the father and all those he begot,
لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ فِيۡ كَبَدٍؕ‏
indeed We have created man (to live) in hard struggle.
اَيَحۡسَبُ اَنۡ لَّنۡ يَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ اَحَدٌۘ‏
Does he think that no one has power over him?
يَقُوۡلُ اَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًاؕ‏
He says, “I have spent a lot of wealth.”
اَيَحۡسَبُ اَنۡ لَّمۡ يَرَهٗ٘ اَحَدٌؕ‏
Does he think that no one has seen him?
اَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلۡ لَّهٗ عَيۡنَيۡنِۙ‏
Did We not make for him two eyes,
وَلِسَانًا وَّشَفَتَيۡنِۙ‏
and one tongue and two lips,
وَهَدَيۡنٰهُ النَّجۡدَيۡنِۚ‏
and showed him the two ways?
فَلَا اقۡتَحَمَ الۡعَقَبَةَؗۖ‏
Yet he did not make his way through the steep course,- -
وَمَا٘ اَدۡرٰىكَ مَا الۡعَقَبَةُؕ‏
- And what may let you know what the steep course is?
فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍۙ‏
(It is) freeing of the neck of a slave,
اَوۡ اِطۡعٰمٌ فِيۡ يَوۡمٍ ذِيۡ مَسۡغَبَةٍۙ‏
or giving food in a day of hunger
يَّتِيۡمًا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍۙ‏
to an orphan near of kin,
اَوۡ مِسۡكِيۡنًا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٍؕ‏
or to a needy person lying in dust- -
ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡمَرۡحَمَةِؕ‏
- then he did not join those who believe and advise each other to be patient and advise each other to be merciful.
اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡمَيۡمَنَةِؕ‏
Those are the People of the Right Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their right hands)
وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا هُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِؕ‏
As for those who reject Our verses, they are the People of the Left Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their left hands.)
عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٌ مُّؤۡصَدَةٌࣖ‏
Upon them will be the Fire, enveloping them with closed exits.
91: وَالشَّمۡسِ وَضُحٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
I swear by the sun and his broad light,
وَالۡقَمَرِ اِذَا تَلٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
and by the moon when she follows him,
وَالنَّهَارِ اِذَا جَلّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
and by the day when it shows his brightness,
وَالَّيۡلِ اِذَا يَغۡشٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
and by the night when it envelops him,
وَالسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
and by the sky, and the One who built it,
وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
and by the earth, and the One who spread it,
وَنَفۡسٍ وَّمَا سَوّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
and by the soul, and the One who made it well,
فَاَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُوۡرَهَا وَتَقۡوٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
then inspired it with its (instincts of) evil and piety,
قَدۡ اَفۡلَحَ مَنۡ زَكّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
success is really attained by him who purifies it,
وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ دَسّٰىهَاؕ‏
and failure is really suffered by him who pollutes it.
كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُ بِطَغۡوٰىهَا٘ۙࣕ‏
(The People of) Thamūd denied the truth because of their transgression,
اِذِ انۭۡ بَعَثَ اَشۡقٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
when rose up the one who was most wretched of them.
فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلُ اللّٰهِ نَاقَةَ اللّٰهِ وَسُقۡيٰهَاؕ‏
So, the Messenger of Allah said to them, “Be careful of Allah’s she-camel and her right to drink.”
فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَعَقَرُوۡهَا ࣢ۙࣕ فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ بِذَنۭۡ بِهِمۡ فَسَوّٰىهَاۙࣕ‏
But they rejected him and killed her, so their Lord sent eradicating torment upon them because of their sin, and made it equal for all.
وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبٰهَاࣖ‏
And He has no fear of its consequence.
92: I swear by the night when it covers (the sun),
and by the day when it unveils itself,
and by the One who created the male and the female,
As for the one who gives (in charity) and fears Allah,
We will facilitate for him the way to extreme ease (i.e. the comforts of Paradise).
But the one who is miser and deems himself self-sufficient,
We will facilitate for him the way to extreme distress.
وَمَا يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡهُ مَالُهٗ٘ اِذَا تَرَدّٰيؕ‏
And his wealth will not help him when he will fall down (into Hell).
Of course, it is undertaken by Us to guide,
and in Our control is the Hereafter and the worldly life.
So I have warned you of a blazing fire.
None will enter it but the wretched one,
who rejected (the truth) and turned away (from it).
And saved from it will be the most God-fearing one,
who gives his wealth (in charity) to become purified,
وَمَا لِاَحَدٍ عِنۡدَهٗ مِنۡ نِّعۡمَةٍ تُجۡزٰ٘يۙ‏
while no one has conferred any favour on him for which he would give a return,
but (he gave his wealth in charity) only to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.
And surely he will soon be happy.
93: and by the night when it becomes peaceful,
your Lord (O Prophet,) has neither forsaken you, nor has become displeased.
Surely the Hereafter is much better for you than the present life.
And of course, your Lord will give you so much that you will be pleased.
Did He not find you an orphan, and give you shelter?
And He found you unaware of the way (the Sharī‘ah ), then He guided you.
and He found you in need, then made you need-free.
Therefore, as for orphan, do not oppress him,
and as for the beggar, do not scold him.
And about the bounty of your Lord, do talk.
94: Have We not caused your bosom to be wide open for you?
And We removed from you your burden
and We raised high your name.
So, undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.
Undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.
So, when you are free (from collective services), toil hard (in worship),
and towards your Lord turn with eagerness.
95: I swear by the Fig and the Olive,
and by Tūr, the mount of Sinai,
لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ فِيۡ٘ اَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيۡمٍؗ‏
We have created man in the best composition,
then We turned him into the lowest of the low,
اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍؕ‏
except those who believed and did righteous deeds, because for them there is a reward never ending.
So, what can make you, after all this, to deny the Requital?
Is Allah not the Greatest Ruler of all the rulers?
96: اِقۡرَاۡ بِاسۡمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَۚ‏
Read with the name of your Lord who created (every thing),
خَلَقَ الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍۚ‏
He created man from a clot of blood.
اِقۡرَاۡ وَرَبُّكَ الۡاَكۡرَمُۙ‏
Read, and your Lord is the most gracious,
الَّذِيۡ عَلَّمَ بِالۡقَلَمِۙ‏
who imparted knowledge by means of the pen.
عَلَّمَ الۡاِنۡسَانَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡؕ‏
He taught man what he did not know.
كَلَّا٘ اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لَيَطۡغٰ٘يۙ‏
In fact, man crosses the limits,
اَنۡ رَّاٰهُ اسۡتَغۡنٰيؕ‏
because he deems himself to be free of need.
اِنَّ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ الرُّجۡعٰيؕ‏
Surely to your Lord is the return.
اَرَءَيۡتَ الَّذِيۡ يَنۡهٰيۙ‏
Have you seen him who forbids
عَبۡدًا اِذَا صَلّٰيؕ‏
a servant of Allah when he prays?
اَرَءَيۡتَ اِنۡ كَانَ عَلَي الۡهُدٰ٘يۙ‏
Tell me, if he is on the right path,
اَوۡ اَمَرَ بِالتَّقۡوٰيؕ‏
or bids piety, (would the former still forbid him?)
اَرَءَيۡتَ اِنۡ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّٰيؕ‏
Tell me, if he rejects (the true faith) and turns away,
اَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَرٰيؕ‏
does he not know that Allah is watching (him)?
كَلَّا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ يَنۡتَهِ ࣢ۙ لَنَسۡفَعًاۭ بِالنَّاصِيَةِۙ‏
No! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag (him) by forelock,
نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۚ‏
a lying, sinful forelock.
فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهٗۙ‏
So let him call the men of his council,
سَنَدۡعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَۙ‏
We will call the soldiers of the Hell.
كَلَّاؕ لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَاسۡجُدۡ وَاقۡتَرِبۡࣛࣖ‏
No! Never obey him, and bow down in sajdah, and come close to Me.
97: We have sent it (the Qur’ān) down in the Night of Qadr.
And what may let you know what the Night of Qadr is?
لَيۡلَةُ الۡقَدۡرِ ࣢ۙ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اَلۡفِ شَهۡرٍؕؔ‏
The Night of Qadr is much better than one thousand months.
تَنَزَّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَالرُّوۡحُ فِيۡهَا بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ اَمۡرٍۙۛ‏
The angels and the Spirit descend in it, with the leave of your Lord, along with every command.
Peace it is till the debut of dawn.
98: لَمۡ يَكُنِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ وَالۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ مُنۡفَكِّيۡنَ حَتّٰي تَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡبَيِّنَةُۙ‏
Those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not (expected) to desist (from their wrong beliefs) unless there comes to them a clear proof,
رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ يَتۡلُوۡا صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةًۙ‏
a messenger from Allah who recites the purified scrolls
وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ الۡبَيِّنَةُؕ‏
And those who were given the Book did not disagree but after the clear proof came to them,
وَمَا٘ اُمِرُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ ࣢ۙ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُؤۡتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَذٰلِكَ دِيۡنُ الۡقَيِّمَةِؕ‏
while they were not ordered but to worship Allah, making their submission exclusive for him with no deviation, and to establish Salāh and pay Zakāh. That is the way of the straight religion.
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ وَالۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ فِيۡ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ الۡبَرِيَّةِؕ‏
Surely those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Jahannam , in which they will be living forever. Those are the worst of all human beings.
اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ الۡبَرِيَّةِؕ‏
As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they are the best of all human beings.
جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَبَدًاؕ رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُوۡا عَنۡهُؕ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهٗࣖ‏

Their reward, with their Lord, is gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow, in which they will be abiding forever. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. That (reward) is for him who has awe of his Lord.
99: When the earth will be trembled with its quake,
and the earth will bring forth its burdens,
and man will say, “What has happened to it?”
That day it will describe all its happenings,
because its Lord will have so commanded it.
يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّصۡدُرُ النَّاسُ اَشۡتَاتًا ࣢ۙ لِّيُرَوۡا اَعۡمَالَهُمۡؕ‏
That day the people will come back (from the place of reckoning) in different groups, so that they may be shown (the fruits of) their deeds.
فَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرًا يَّرَهٗؕ‏
So, whoever does any good act (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.
وَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَّرَهٗࣖ‏
And whoever does evil (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.
100: وَالۡعٰدِيٰتِ ضَبۡحًاۙ‏
